Finance Analyst/ Account Analyst
description:
Atrium Housing is a mission-driven real estate development firm focused on creating affordable housing and vibrant communities. Our projects span mixed-finance and LIHTC transactions, and we pride ourselves on delivering high-quality, impactful housing solutions while fostering a collaborative, supportive, and growth-oriented work environment.



At Atrium, you’ll have the opportunity to learn directly from experienced development professionals, work on meaningful projects that impact communities, and build a strong foundation for a career in real estate finance and affordable housing development.



Role Purpose



As a Development Analyst, you’ll support affordable housing transactions through financial underwriting, due diligence coordination, and application support. While LIHTC experience is a plus, it is not required—what matters most is your analytical mindset, attention to detail, and eagerness to learn.



Primary Value You’ll Bring:



* Accurate underwriting and financial modeling

* Organized and reliable diligence tracking

* High-quality application support for housing agencies, investors, and lenders



What You’ll Do



* Build and maintain detailed financial models and sources-and-uses statements (LIHTC exposure is a bonus)

* Prepare rent schedules, operating pro formas, and subsidy layering analyses

* Support preparation of state housing agency applications

* Coordinate third-party reports such as market studies, appraisals, environmental studies, and surveys

* Maintain due diligence and closing checklists

* Assist with investor, lender, and internal memos



What We’re Looking For



Technical Competencies:



* Intermediate to advanced Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, modeling)

* LIHTC fundamentals (ideal, not required)

* Strong data organization



Behavioral Competencies:



* High attention to detail

* Responsiveness and proactive communication

* Strong accountability and ownership



Qualifications:



* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Real Estate, Economics, Planning, or related field

* 0–3 years of relevant experience

* Strong analytical and organizational skills

* Performance Metrics

* Accuracy and reliability of underwriting

* Timeliness of deliverables

* Quality and completeness of application materials

* Responsiveness to team and project needs



Why You’ll Love Working at Atrium Housing



* Impactful work: Contribute to projects that provide affordable housing and improve communities.

* Professional growth: Learn from experienced development professionals and gain exposure to mixed-finance and LIHTC projects.

* Collaborative culture: Work with a supportive, mission-driven team where your contributions matter.

* Flexible remote work: Balance your professional growth with personal life while collaborating across time zones.



To apply, answer these questions via vocaroo and send your link.

1. What struck your interest about the role?

2. What's your experience in handling finance especially in the construction industry?

3. Attach the LINK to your updated resume.

title: Construction Accounting
description:
We’re hiring a Project Accountant to support construction, loan, and compliance operations across multiple affordable housing developments. If you’re detail-driven, good with documentation, and like work that has real impact, this is a strong long-term fit.



Why You’ll Love This Role



You will work directly with decision-makers — your work will be visible and valued.

You will help keep projects compliant, funded, and on schedule.

No bureaucracy, no busywork — your work directly moves projects forward.

Real room to grow into senior financial coordination or project support.



Your Typical Day

Organize and maintain project financial and compliance documentation.

Support the preparation of monthly construction draw requests.

Communicate with contractors to collect invoices, lien waivers, and documents.

Update budgets, change order logs, and payment tracking sheets.

Coordinate with lenders, accounting, and project managers as needed.



What You’ll Be Doing



1) Loan & Draw Support

Compile lien waivers, invoices, schedules, and supporting docs for draw packages.

Compare cost reports to contracts, change orders, and lender requirements.

Track soft costs (architect, engineering, inspections, interest, title, etc.).

Prepare clear, organized submission files for lenders.



2) Construction Financial Administration

Maintain digital project files (contracts, pay apps, insurance, permits, payrolls).

Track executed change orders against pay apps and budgets.

Monitor buyout logs, completion schedules, and compliance documents.

Follow up with contractors until documentation is accurate and complete.



3) General Coordination & Reporting

Maintain trackers, logs, and internal reports.

Prepare agendas, notes, and status reports for project meetings.

Communicate professionally with internal and external stakeholders.

Handle confidential financial data with discretion.



What We’re Looking For

2–4+ years in project accounting, construction admin, or loan/draw processing.

Familiarity with construction draws, budgets, or lender compliance preferred.

Proficiency in Excel and document management tools (Procore/Built/Buildertrend a bonus).

Extremely organized, detail-accurate, and accountable to deadlines.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Experience working for a US construction company or real-estate developer



Nice to Have

Experience in real estate development or affordable housing.

Knowledge of construction accounting.

Experience with billing using AIA G702/G703 forms.

Degree in Accounting, Construction Mgmt, Business, or related field.



TO APPLY: send a recording via 
 and answer these questions:

1.) What struck your interest about the role?

2.) Tell me about your experience in construction accounting?



SUBJECT: Construction Accounting - YOUR NAME



About Us



Atrium Housing is a mission-driven affordable housing developer with an affiliated construction company with offices in Louisiana, Florida and Texas. We don’t just build buildings — we create opportunities for families and communities. Our finance and construction teams work with lenders, contractors, and public partners to move projects from concept to completion.

title: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator
description:
We are hiring a Real Estate Transaction Coordinator, but this is for a SPECIFIC person! 



You must have experience in de-escalating tense situations. This is not a strictly admin/filing role. Your job is onboarding homeowners who sign a contract and keeping them on board all the way to closing. There will also be some additional work to do as we are a start-up; essentially, you are freeing up the owner to be on the phone selling 10hr/day. You must have very good English and be extremely comfortable on the phone!



Examples just this week from two clients: "I'm not closing on this now I know there is a $10,000 lien on this property" (she signed a contract that says all liens are to be paid by her) and "I need at least 30 days. This is all moving too fast. I need to call the bank and make sure i can sell this and not be responsible for mortgage payment after closing" (His contract says he'd provide access within 24hr and also he's 15 months behind on mortgage payments).



To apply for this position, mention what you would do in the above situations via video and send the link for our team to watch.

- Review and approve ticket responses drafted by customer support representatives

- Check for accuracy, tone, grammar, and completeness before responses are sent

- Give clear, constructive feedback to reps to help them improve

- Flag recurring issues or patterns to the manager

- Help maintain and update response templates and SOPs

title: Supply Chain & Logistics Lead (Amazon FBA Private Label Brands)
description:
We run two complementary Amazon FBA brands: one in a premium giftable category with strong Christmas seasonality, one in sports & fitness. We are at ~200 SKUs today, with a clear roadmap to ~500. We sell on 
, .
, 
, manufacture in China, and ship into FBA, AWD, and 3PLs across the US, UK, and Canada.



** THE ROLE **



This is a senior role. The CEO and Head of Operations are looking for a trusted operator to take ownership of the supply chain and logistics function, “end-to-end”, from initial forecasting -to- factory floor -to- FBA shelf. Someone we can hand the keys to and trust to drive it forward with little oversight.



You'll inherit a well-documented operation, with a structured onboarding: our current Supply Chain Manager will support your transition, transferring knowledge of both brands, our suppliers, and our systems so you can take the reins with confidence.



We also expect you to work AI-first. The best person for this role uses AI daily: to pressure-test forecasts, draft communications, build formulas, and automate the repetitive parts of logistics coordination. At the same time, you verify every output before it touches a decision. AI leverage is how one sharp operator runs what used to take a full department.



** WHAT YOU WILL OWN **



— Supply chain strategy and execution across both brands, “end-to-end”. Each runs its own forecasting methodology; you'll master both and standardise where it genuinely helps

— Demand forecasting and order planning for 200 SKUs (scaling to 500), built in Google Sheets with the backing of solid data flows

— China manufacturer relationships: production scheduling, inspections, quality, MOQ and pricing negotiation, alternate sourcing

— International freight and logistics coordination: coordinator of carrier selection, cost vs. transit time, customs compliance, freight forwarders, 3PLs

— FBA inventory health: 45 to 90 days cover, avoiding stockouts and overstock, inbound receiving discrepancies, reimbursements, cases with Amazon

— The small, critical details: barcodes, FNSKUs, shipment labeling, compliance documentation, tracking reconciliation. You are the last line of defense

— A performance dashboard you build and own: forecast accuracy, inventory turnover, lead time, on-time-in-full, stockout rate, shipping cost per unit, cashflow planning

— Alignment with marketing and sales, so inventory matches promotional plans and seasonality. Flagged early, with numbers

— Task and process management in ClickUp: every shipment, order, supplier action, and follow-up lives in ClickUp so the whole team has visibility and nothing falls through the cracks. You will be expected to maintain it rigorously, not treat it as optional

— Proactive communication: updates prior to asking, risks flagged early, follow-through without being chased



** WHAT OWNERSHIP MEANS HERE **



In supply chain management, small mistakes compound: one wrong barcode or missed reorder point can be costly. So we work to a clear standard. Sanity checking is built into how you operate: reconciling totals, second-passing formulas, and gut-checking outputs against reality before they drive a decision. Occasional errors are part of the job; what we can't carry is the same error recurring, going unnoticed, or going unexplained. When something does go wrong, you own it: what happened, why, the impact, and the fix that stops it repeating. Work like that, and you'll have our full backing when things go sideways.



** MUST HAVES: SKILLS & EXPERIENCE **



— 4+ years in supply chain, with 2+ years personally running an Amazon FBA supply chain “end-to-end” (Bachelor's in Supply Chain or related field is a plus)

— Proven experience managing 100+ SKUs; multi-brand portfolios a plus

— Deep international logistics knowledge: sea freight, customs, import/export compliance

— Strong Seller Central command: restock/capacity limits, IPI, shipment creation, FNSKU and barcode management, AWD vs. FBA 

— Advanced Google Sheets/Excel. You build models, not just populate them (array formulas,  pivot tables, QUERY, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, IMPORTRANGE). We will ask to see analyses you've built.

— Demonstrable AI fluency: real examples of AI saving you hours, and of catching it when it was wrong or hallucinating

— Experience with seasonal products and Christmas demand spikes

— Comfortable delegating and reviewing the work of others when needed

— Fluent English, written and verbal (Mandarin/Chinese a bonus for supplier communications in their native language)



** WORK SETUP **



Reliable electricity and 50+ Mbps internet, your own computer, and a quiet workspace. We run all tasks, processes, and reporting through ClickUp: it is our central hub for visibility across the team, and strong comfort with it is a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Working hours must cross over with China and UK hours (e.g. roughly 2pm to 10pm PH time, or a split shift like PHT 10am to 2pm & 6pm to 10pm). We're flexible on the shape, as long as the crossover is there.



** PERSONALITY WE'RE LOOKING FOR **



A logician's mind: structured, methodical, rigorous. Obsessively detail-oriented, so spotting an off barcode or an ambiguously worded supplier quote is your default mode, not an effort. The right fit is someone with real agency: you push for action, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and juggle parallel priorities without losing oversight of the details. An independent operator and self-starter who stays calm under pressure during peak-season spikes and shipping delays. Fully accountable. Always improving the system.



** NOT A FIT IF YOU **



— Need step-by-step instructions

— Are a generalist VA with peripheral supply chain exposure

— Have not personally managed an FBA supply chain “end-to-end”

— Find details tedious, or paste AI output without checking it

— Are juggling multiple other clients



** THE PACKAGE **



— Full-time, 40 hrs/week; bi-weekly salary (3rd and 18th of the month)

— $1,900 to $2,400/month base (PHP 120,000 to 150,000), equivalent to $11 to $14 per hour, depending on experience

— 13th-month pay, pro-rated each December

— Health reimbursement up to $50/month (HMO, PhilHealth, Maxicare, etc.)



** HOW TO APPLY **



Complete the application form below. It includes a few short questions and two brief video uploads (you can submit partially and return to finish later):



Apply via this link:

title: Meta Media Buyer / GHL Specialist Builder - US Performance Marketing Agency for Home Care
description:
We're a fast-growing performance marketing agency (
) serving non-medical home care agencies across the US.



We run
 Ads, build funnels, and manage lead nurture systems in GoHighLevel for our clients. We're onboarding 5–10+ new clients per week and need a GHL Build + Ads Specialist who owns the complete technical setup for every new client — from GHL sub-account to live
 campaign — and gets each client live on a launch call.



You are the person who takes a new client from "just signed" to "ads running and leads coming in." Every new client that comes through, you build their GoHighLevel account, launch their
 campaign, and walk them through the launch.



Speed, accuracy, and consistency matter. You'll follow detailed SOPs and checklists for every build.



This is a hands-on execution role with a client-facing finish. You follow the playbook, you get it right every time, you get the client live, and you move to the next one. If you love working in GHL and Ads Manager all day, take pride in fast, clean builds, and you're confident and clear on a video call with a US business owner — this is your role.





A professional-quality microphone — crisp, clean audio with no static or echo. Laptop/built-in mics are not acceptable.

Proven ability to communicate with business owners — you can hold a professional conversation, explain things simply, set expectations, and make a busy owner feel confident and taken care of.



Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional space for video calls.



What You'll Do Every Day:



GHL BUILD (per client):

Deploy GHL snapshot to new sub-account

Set custom values: agency name, pricing, service area, calendar URL, location ID, API key

Purchase and configure phone number (LeadConnector)

Submit A2P 10DLC registration and monitor approval status

Customize landing page: swap pricing, logo, calendar URL, branding

Configure calendar: availability, buffer times, booking window, staff assignments

Configure pipeline: verify all stages and triggers are connected

QA every build before the client launch call



ADS SETUP (per client):



Receive or request Ads Manager access from client (coordinate with Ops Manager if delayed)

Duplicate our proven campaign template into each client's Ad Account

Swap ad copy variables: agency name, city, service area, offer details

Upload creative from our library or client-provided assets

Set geographic targeting for the client's service area

Configure
 Pixel and custom conversion events

Set campaign to correct objective (Leads) and Special Ad Category (Housing)

Set daily budget per client instructions

Launch campaign and verify delivery within 24 hours

Troubleshoot: ad rejected, stuck in review, pixel not firing, payment issues



CLIENT LAUNCH (per client):



Run the client-facing launch call: confirm everything is built and live, walk the client through their setup, train them to respond to leads fast, set expectations, and hand over their portal

Confirm calendar availability and credentials directly with the client on the call



ONGOING:



Execute bulk sub-account updates when we change offers or processes across all clients

Monitor A2P approval statuses across all accounts

Document new issues or edge cases for the troubleshooting playbook

Coordinate with Client Ops Manager on launch timing and pending items



What You Won't Do:



Own the ongoing client relationship or account management (the Ops Manager owns the ongoing relationship — you run the technical launch that gets them live)

Build or modify GHL workflows from scratch (Albert handles that)

Ongoing ad campaign optimization or creative strategy (handled separately)

Make strategic decisions about funnels, offers, or targeting



Required Skills — GHL:



Hands-on GoHighLevel experience (non-negotiable — you must already know GHL)



Sub-accounts: creating, navigating, switching between locations

Snapshots: deploying and verifying

Custom Values: setting and editing

Calendars: configuring availability, staff, booking settings

Pipelines: stages, opportunities, triggers

Phone Numbers: purchasing via LeadConnector, setting default outbound

Funnel Builder: basic text/image editing within existing pages

Workflows: reading and understanding (not building from scratch)



Experience with A2P 10DLC registration (or willingness to learn fast — we have SOPs)



Required Skills —
 Ads / Media Buying / GHL builds



 Ads Manager experience (non-negotiable)



Business Manager: switching between ad accounts, managing partner access

Campaign structure: campaigns, ad sets, ads

Audience targeting: location, age, demographics

 Pixel: verification, custom conversions, event tracking

Lead Generation objective with instant forms

Special Ad Categories: Housing category and its targeting limitations

Troubleshooting: rejections, restricted accounts, delivery issues



Required Skills — General:



Detail-oriented — every custom value, every targeting setting, every budget must be right

Fast — a complete build (GHL + Ads) should take 60–90 minutes per client once trained

Reliable internet and quiet workspace

Available during US business hours (Central Time preferred, flexible on exact hours)

Strong written English (you'll communicate with the team daily via Slack/chat) and perfect spoken English (see client-facing requirements above)

Able to follow SOPs precisely and flag anything that doesn't match the playbook



Nice to Have:



Experience with Twilio

Experience with Make or Zapier

Basic HTML/CSS for landing page tweaks

Experience with CAPI (Conversions API) setup

Familiarity with Canva or basic image editing

Experience in a marketing agency managing multiple client accounts simultaneously

Experience in home care, healthcare, or senior services marketing



About the Team:

You'll report to the Client Operations Manager, who owns the ongoing client relationship. Albert (CTO) handles all workflow logic, AI agents, and system architecture. You handle the builds, the launches, and getting each client live. We work as a tight team and communicate daily.



We're building AI agents that will eventually automate parts of this process so you'll be working alongside automation, not against it. Your SOPs today become the foundation for what our AI handles tomorrow



Schedule:

Full-time, Monday–Friday. Must overlap with US business hours (8 AM – 5 PM Central Time). Some flexibility on exact start/end times as long as core hours are covered.



How to Apply:

Please include ALL of the following in your application:



To apply send a loom video explaining what is listed below and why you would be a good fit.



Describe your GoHighLevel experience — how many sub-accounts have you built or managed? What did your build process look like?



Describe your
 Ads Manager experience — how many ad accounts have you set up campaigns in?



What is the fastest you've gone from receiving a new client's info to having their GHL account built AND ads live?



Do you have experience with A2P 10DLC registration? If yes, describe it briefly.



Include a 1–2 minute video introduction of why you would be a good fit (any link) so we can hear your spoken English and see your webcam and microphone quality.



Include the word "FullStack" at the top of your application so I know you read this entire listing.



Generic applications will be ignored. We are looking for someone who has done both 
 and
 Ads, and is comfortable onboarding 5-10 clients per week.  not someone who wants to learn one of them on the job.

title: “Send and Delete” Virtual Assistant — Future Right Hand
description:
Read this carefully before applying.



I’m not looking for a typical virtual assistant.



I’m looking for someone I can send a task to—and immediately delete it from my brain.



Once I assign something to you, I want to consider it handled.



No chasing.



No repeated reminders.



No asking, “Did you ever finish that?”



No letting tasks quietly disappear.



You take ownership of the outcome, complete the task, communicate what happened, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



That is the standard.



What “Send and Delete” Means



When I give you a responsibility, you own the entire outcome—not just the first step.



You do not wait for me to remember it.



You do not stop when something becomes slightly difficult.



You follow up.



You find missing information.



You solve reasonable problems independently.



You keep me updated without needing to be asked.



If something cannot be completed, you tell me immediately, explain why, and present the next-best solution.



I should never have to continue carrying the task in my head after assigning it to you.



About Us



I’m Kaleb, and I’m building multiple home-service businesses in the United States.



You will initially help support our growing fence and cleaning businesses, but this position is designed to grow alongside the companies.



As we launch and expand additional businesses, you will become an important part of helping operate all of them.



This is not a dead-end VA position.



I’m looking for someone who wants to become my right hand and help build something long-term.



The Main Purpose of This Role



Your job is not simply to answer calls or complete random administrative tasks.



Your job is to help create growth.



Every working day, you should be helping us:



* Convert more leads into appointments

* Turn appointments into paying customers

* Generate more organic attention

* Build our online reputation

* Create valuable local relationships

* Recruit reliable subcontractors

* Improve our systems

* Remove responsibilities from my plate



You will handle opportunities coming into the business today while also building assets that create more opportunities tomorrow.



What You’ll Do



Answer and Convert Inbound Calls



You will answer incoming calls from American customers and help move them toward booking an appointment.



You will be responsible for:



* Answering calls quickly and professionally

* Returning missed calls immediately

* Asking the correct qualifying questions

* Explaining our process clearly

* Booking qualified appointments

* Entering complete and accurate information into our system

* Following up with callers who do not immediately book

* Confirming upcoming appointments

* Rescheduling cancellations

* Continuing to follow up until there is a final outcome



You are not simply taking messages.



You are helping convert interested callers into paying customers.



Respond to New Leads



You will monitor and respond to:



* Website inquiries

* Text messages

*
 and 
ssages

*
s

* Missed calls

* Lead forms

* Quote requests



Speed matters.



A lead that waits several hours for a response can become someone else’s customer.



Recruit Subcontractors



Finding dependable subcontractors is one of the most important responsibilities in this role.



You will:



* Find local subcontractors through
 groups, Google, Craigslist, job boards, and direct outreach

* Contact contractors who already advertise their services

* Screen potential subcontractors

* Collect pricing, service areas, availability, references, insurance information, and photos of previous work

* Schedule interviews or test jobs

* Follow up with promising candidates

* Maintain an organized subcontractor database

* Help us build primary, backup, and emergency contractor options

* Continue recruiting even when we already have someone available



The goal is not to collect random names.



The goal is to build a dependable network of people who answer, show up, communicate, and complete quality work.



Create and Publish Daily Content



You will help us consistently build our brands by publishing useful local content.



This may include:



* Before-and-after projects

* Customer reviews

* Frequently asked questions

* Pricing explanations

* Seasonal service reminders

* Common homeowner mistakes

* Local project highlights

* Educational posts

* Service offers

* Short videos or graphics



Content may be published on:



*

* Instagram

* Google Business Profile

* Local community groups when appropriate

* Our websites



The expectation is not to publish generic “Call us today” posts.



The content should be useful, local, creative, and designed to make customers trust us.



Follow Up With Leads and Past Customers



You will consistently work our customer database instead of allowing opportunities to disappear.



This includes:



* Following up with leads who never booked

* Following up on unsold estimates

* Contacting previous customers about repeat services

* Reactivating canceled appointments

* Following up with people who asked to be contacted later

* Asking satisfied customers for referrals

* Requesting Google reviews

* Following up on unanswered review requests



Build Referral Partnerships



You will help develop relationships with businesses that already serve our ideal customers.



Potential partners may include:



* Realtors

* Property managers

* Landlords

* Home inspectors

* Landscapers

* Pool companies

* Deck builders

* Concrete companies

* Restoration companies

* Moving companies

* Other complementary home-service businesses



You will find potential partners, contact them, explain how we can help each other, follow up, and maintain an organized partnership database.



Help Improve Our Systems



You will help document and improve how the businesses operate.



This may include:



* Improving call scripts

* Creating follow-up sequences

* Building subcontractor intake systems

* Organizing customer information

* Improving our CRM

* Documenting standard operating procedures

* Creating trackers and dashboards

* Identifying repetitive work that can be automated

* Finding better ways to complete recurring tasks



A major advantage is experience with Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, AI tools, automations, or building simple internal systems.



You do not need to be a professional developer.



However, you should be creative, curious, willing to experiment, and capable of using modern tools to solve problems.



I want someone who can look at a messy process and think:



“How can we make this better?”



Your Daily Priorities



You will work in this order:



1. Live inbound calls

2. Brand-new customer leads

3. Missed calls and unanswered inquiries

4. Appointments happening today

5. Open estimates and follow-ups

6. Subcontractor recruiting

7. Organic customer acquisition

8. Reviews, referrals, content, and partnerships

9. Systems and administrative work



Revenue-producing tasks always come before low-priority administrative work.



You should never be organizing files while a hot customer lead is waiting for a response.



What Success Looks Like



The people who succeed here are:



* Extremely responsive

* Excellent communicators

* Comfortable speaking with American customers

* Organized

* Detail-oriented

* Creative

* Resourceful

* Fast learners

* Independent thinkers

* Comfortable making decisions

* Hungry to improve

* Able to solve problems without constant supervision

* Obsessed with following through



I do not want someone who simply completes today’s task list.



I want someone who makes my life easier because they take ownership.



What Will Not Work



This position is not for you if you:



* Regularly need reminders

* Disappear during working hours

* Wait for instructions all day

* Say “done” when the task is only partially complete

* Ignore problems instead of communicating them

* Make excuses instead of searching for solutions

* Forget customer follow-ups

* Require constant supervision

* Complete work without checking it

* Are uncomfortable speaking on the phone

* Treat this as another temporary online gig



Mistakes can be corrected.



A lack of ownership cannot.



Compensation



This position pays a base hourly rate plus significant performance bonuses.



Base Pay



You will receive:



$2.50 per hour during scheduled working hours



The hourly pay covers your availability and completion of ongoing growth and operational responsibilities, including:



* Answering calls

* Responding to leads

* Following up with customers

* Recruiting subcontractors

* Publishing content

* Requesting reviews

* Contacting referral partners

* Improving systems

* Completing assigned operational work



This is not a position where you sit and wait for the phone to ring.



Inbound Phone Performance Bonuses



In addition to your hourly pay, you can earn:



*$25 for every qualified appointment booked from an inbound call

* +$25 when the appointment is complete

* +$75 when the customer becomes a paying client



One inbound phone lead that becomes a paying customer can earn you $125 in bonuses, in addition to your hourly pay.



That can often times double for customers who booked with follow-up. 



A qualified appointment must:



* Be located within our service area

* Be for a service we currently provide

* Include complete and accurate customer information

* Be scheduled for a legitimate date and time

* Be properly documented in our system

* Follow our approved qualification and booking process



Fake, duplicate, incomplete, unqualified, canceled, or improperly scheduled appointments will not qualify for bonuses.



Future Growth



For the RIGHT individual



* Major Increased hourly pay

* Additional performance bonuses

* Greater responsibility

* Management opportunities

* A stable monthly salary

* A long-term position helping operate multiple companies



I believe the people who create the most value should have the opportunity to earn the most.



What I’m Really Looking For



I’m not looking for someone to “help me.”



I’m looking for someone who eventually helps run the businesses.



Someone I can trust.



Someone who follows through.



Someone who notices things other people miss.



Someone who makes customers feel taken care of.



Someone who constantly asks:



* What needs to happen next?

* Who still needs a response?

* What could become a problem?

* What can I take off Kaleb’s plate?

* How can this process be improved?

* What can I do today that will create growth tomorrow?



If you become that person, I will continue investing in you as the businesses grow.



To Apply



Do not send me a generic application.



Start your application with the phrase:



SEND AND DELETE

title: Eligibility, Benefits, & Prior Authorization Specialist
description:
PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR APPLICATION HERE:







Job Title: Eligibility, Benefits, & Prior Authorization Specialist

Location: 100% Remote (Offshore)

Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor

Compensation: $600-$800

Hours: 40 hours/week, primarily EST business hours

Reports to: Operations / Revenue Cycle Lead



About Josi Health

Josi Health is a fast-growing, virtual-first healthcare company dedicated to making  neurodivergent care (including evaluations & therapy) faster, more accessible, and stress-free for families. We operate across 40+ states, navigating a complex landscape of commercial insurance carriers and state Medicaid programs. Because our clinical model is virtual-first, having bulletproof front-end patient access and benefit structures is critical to preventing administrative delays and billing denials.



About the Role

We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-obsessed Eligibility, Benefits, & Prior Authorization Specialist who loves the investigative side of healthcare administration. In this role, you will not just perform data entry. You will act as an internal researcher and gatekeeper, digging into payor portals, insurance policy and benefits updates, and clinical guidelines to uncover the exact steps needed to secure prior authorizations and verify complex telehealth benefits.



This role is a blend of high-velocity queue management and deep-dive policy research. You will review incoming clinical orders, cross-reference them with payer requirements, clear daily scheduling queues, and build process playbooks where none exist. If you thrive on solving insurance puzzles, de-escalating complex scheduling bottlenecks, and keeping clinical schedules perfectly authorized, you will excel here.



Key Responsibilities



1. Insurance Verification & Telehealth Benefit Research

- Verify active patient insurance coverage, deductibles, co-pays, co-insurance, and coordination of benefits (COB) across commercial plans

- Conduct in-depth research on payer-specific policies regarding virtual care, remote developmental pediatrics, and psychological evaluations (CPT 90791, 96130, etc.)

- Navigate payor websites, newsletters, and provider manuals to track and document shifting policy guidelines and billing modifiers across 40+ states



2. Order Verification & Prior Authorization Management

- Review incoming clinical diagnostic referrals and orders to ensure demographic, insurance, CPT, and ICD-10 data are flawless

- Initiate, track, and validate prior authorizations through clearinghouses (e.g., Availity, Waystar), insurance portals, and phone escalations

- Ensure all authorizations are secured, confirmed accurate, and fully documented in the EMR before the close of business each day for upcoming clinics



3. Ambiguity Resolution & Playbook Creation

- Act as the go-to resource for clinical teams when a payer's prior-authorization process is vague, contradictory, or unmapped

- Validate conflicting information from multiple insurance sources to determine the most credible, risk-free path for claim submission

- Build, update, and maintain internal state-by-state reference guides on commercial insurance and state-by-state regulatory requirements



4. Clinic Coordination & Stakeholder Communication

- Prepare clear, professional patient insurance benefit letters outlining estimated out-of-pocket costs and referral requirements

- Collaborate closely with clinic coordinators and clinical staff to resolve last-minute scheduling exceptions or authorization gaps

- Help de-escalate patient or provider concerns regarding coverage limits with professional, empathetic communication



What We're Looking For



Must-Have

- 2+ years of healthcare clinic or startup experience specializing in insurance verification and prior authorizations

- Strong research capabilities: deep comfort navigating payor portals, digging through policy manuals, and calling payor representatives to clarify ambiguous rules

- Hands-on experience working with multiple major commercial payers (e.g., BCBS, Optum, Aetna)

- Working knowledge of medical terminology, CPT, ICD-10, and telehealth billing modifiers

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills: ability to translate technical insurance terms into simple, clear explanations

- High-speed internet, backup power setup, and the ability to work full-time during EST business hours



Preferred (Not Required)

- Medicaid familiarity is a plus

- Experience in virtual care, digital health, or behavioral/mental health environments

- Experience utilizing modern EHRs (e.g., Athenahealth) or CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)

- Experience building internal SOPs or process documentation from scratch



What We Offer

- 100% remote work from anywhere outside the US

- Competitive monthly compensation in USD

- The opportunity to join a fast-growing, mission-driven team with clear professional growth

- Full access to modern operational tools and tech



How to Apply

1. Upload your resume (PDF)

2. Complete our qualification questionnaire

3. Submit

title: Revenue Cycle Management Specialist
description:
PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR APPLICATION HERE:







REVENUE CYCLE MANAGEMENT SPECIALIST



Job Title: Revenue Cycle Management Specialist (Non-US)

Location: 100% Remote (Offshore)

Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor

Compensation: $700-$2,000 

Hours: 40 hours/week, primarily EST business hours

Reports to: Operations / Revenue Cycle Lead



About Josi Health

Josi Health is a fast-growing remote healthcare company focused on making neurodivergent care (including evaluations & therapy) more accessible, faster, and less stressful for families. We operate across 40+ states and work with major insurance carriers. Every claim we submit correctly means another family gets care without billing delays.



About the Role

We are looking for a detail-obsessed Revenue Cycle Management Specialist to own the full claims lifecycle – from claim submission and scrubbing to payment posting, AR follow-up, and denial resolution. You will ensure that every claim is submitted accurately, every denial is challenged, and every payment is reconciled.



This is not a passive billing role. You will be the person who catches errors before claims go out, follows up relentlessly on unpaid claims, and identifies patterns that prevent denials from happening in the first place. If you hate leaving money on the table and enjoy the puzzle of resolving claim discrepancies, you will thrive here.



Key Responsibilities



Billing and Claims Submission

- Prepare, review, and submit accurate claims to commercial payers (e.g., Aetna, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, UnitedHealthcare, Optum)

- Verify and ensure the accuracy of billing codes (CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10) and modifiers for services rendered, with a focus on behavioral health and virtual care codes

- Scrub claims for errors in demographics, eligibility, authorization, coding completeness, and payer-specific requirements before submission

- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of commercial insurance billing requirements, with a focus on behavioral health and telehealth regulations

- Use billing software and clearinghouses to process and track claims

- Ensure timely filing requirements are met for all assigned payers



Accounts Receivable Management

- Monitor claim status and follow up on unpaid, underpaid, and denied claims promptly

- Investigate and resolve claim discrepancies, denials, and appeals

- Submit corrected claims and appeals when necessary

- Maintain AR aging across assigned payer relationships – work buckets by age and priority

- Review EOBs and denial trends to identify recurring issues and root causes

- Generate reports for outstanding accounts receivable and payment trends



Payment Posting and Reconciliation

- Post insurance and patient payments accurately (manual and electronic)

- Reconcile ERA/EOB payments against expected reimbursement

- Identify and resolve underpayments, overpayments, and credit balances

- Process refunds to insurance and patients in compliance with regulations



Compliance and Documentation

- Ensure all billing practices comply with federal, state, and local regulations

- Verify patient insurance information, eligibility, and prior authorization requirements

- Maintain accurate records of billing activities and patient accounts

- Follow HIPAA regulations to ensure patient confidentiality

- Support internal audits and quality reviews as requested



Communication and Coordination

- Collaborate with office staff, clinical teams, and payers to address billing and reimbursement issues

- Proactive about providing feedback to benefits verification team to ensure upfront accurate patient out of pocket estimates

- Provide clear communication to patients regarding their billing, payments, and financial responsibilities

- Respond to inquiries from payers, patients, and colleagues in a professional and timely manner

- Flag recurring pre-submission error patterns with recommendations for upstream fixes



What We're Looking For



Must-Have

- 2+ years of experience in medical billing, AR follow-up, claims processing, or revenue cycle operations

- Knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding

- Experience with claim clearinghouses and payer portals

- Experienced with CMS 1500 forms

- Expert knowledge of Google Sheets/Excel to create their own reporting & analysis

- Strong attention to detail – you catch errors before they become rejections

- Ability to manage multiple claims and deadlines simultaneously

- Familiarity with Availity and other payer portals

- Proactive follow-through – you don't wait for payers to respond; you call them

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills

- Reliable remote work setup with backup power and internet (EST hours)



Preferred (Not Required)

- Experience in behavioral health, ABA, or therapy billing

- Experience with multi-state billing and payer enrollment

- Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) certification

- Experience in a startup or fast-growing healthcare organization

- Associate's or Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, or related field



What We Offer

- Fully remote – work from anywhere outside the US

- Competitive monthly compensation in USD

- Ownership of a critical function with direct impact on revenue

- Autonomy – we trust you to own your deadlines

- Supportive, collaborative team culture



How to Apply

1. Upload your resume (PDF)

2. Complete the short questionnaire

3. Submit

title: Accounting Manager
description:
About the Role



As an Accounting Manager, you will serve as the accounting lead on multiple client engagements across diverse industries, including consumer goods, SaaS, business services, manufacturing, and healthcare.



We are seeking a seasoned accounting professional with 8+ years of experience, including 3+ years in US accounting and at least 2 years of team leadership. This role is ideal for someone who loves process, obsesses over the numbers, and takes pride in delivering high-quality work. The ideal candidate is a self-proclaimed perfectionist with a passion for collaborating cross-functionally with both internal teams and clients.



You’ll work closely with our growing finance and accounting team (who are actually a lot of fun!) and gain regular exposure to senior leaders at both the firm and our client organizations.



What’s In It for You

-   Compensation & Perks: Competitive salary (commensurate with experience), 13th-month pay, and an annual salary increase + performance-based bonus program.

-   Time Off: 10 days of PTO (vacation, sick, and personal days) plus observance of 12 regular Philippine holidays.

-   Schedule: Weekday shift from 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM Manila Time. Willingness to occasionally work extended hours as project requirements dictate (dedication and hard work are recognized and rewarded through bonuses).

-   Flexibility & Growth: Fully remote (work from the comfort of your home), full-time role as an Independent Contractor (no BPO involvement), offering a long-term opportunity with career growth and advancement.



Duties and Responsibilities

-   Financial Oversight: Ensure accurate and timely completion of month-end close processes and oversee accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR) functions.

-   Reporting & Compliance: Prepare, review, and present financial statements in accordance with US GAAP, and produce comprehensive financial reports for internal and client review.

-   Strategy & Optimization: Perform in-depth financial analysis to support strategic decision-making, and evaluate, enhance, and streamline financial systems and processes.

-   Client & Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and support team members to ensure high-quality deliverables, while partnering closely with clients to provide financial insights and ongoing guidance.



Qualifications

-   Education & Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy; Certified Public Accountant (CPA) is required.

-   Experience: 8+ years of accounting experience, including at least 3 years in US accounting (US firm background preferred).

-   Leadership: 2+ years of experience leading or supervising a team.

-   Technical Domain: Experience with tangible goods and inventory management.

-   Software & Tools: Proficiency in QuickBooks Online.

-   Soft Skills: Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and strong written and verbal communication skills.



Nice-to-Haves

-   Master of Business Administration (MBA)

-   eCommerce accounting experience

-   Familiarity with NetSuite and Xero

-   Strong client-facing communication and meeting facilitation skills



Additional Requirements

-   Hardware: Own equipment (preferably Microsoft OS) with an extra monitor.

-   Connectivity: Reliable, stable, high-speed internet connection.

-   Workspace: A secluded workstation to ensure a private and distraction-free work environment.



Ideal Candidate Profile



We look for leaders who embody these core values:

-   Make yourself heard: Be confident in sharing informed perspectives with internal teams and clients.

-   Challenge the status quo: Embrace innovation, automation, and modern accounting solutions.

-   Find solutions: Identify root causes and deliver practical, impactful solutions.

-   Always be learning: Stay curious and continuously improve your skills.

-   Proactive progress: Take ownership and drive execution.

-   Be a perfectionist: Take pride in delivering exceptional work.



Ready to Apply?



Are you the Accounting Manager we’ve been looking for? If you’re ready to take the next step in your career, submit your application today!



Candidate Notice

This is a direct independent contractor engagement with the hiring company. This is not a BPO or agency placement. Compensation is paid monthly in USD, and candidates are responsible for any applicable local taxes and statutory obligations.

title: Customer Service Rep
description:
As our morning customer service rep, you're the first point of contact each day. You handle all incoming
s in the morning, making sure every customer gets a reply within our response-time targets. A colleague takes over in the afternoon, so a clean handover and accurate record-keeping matter.



You'll work from a detailed SOP with fixed templates for everything from order status to returns, defects, warranty, address changes, discounts, and escalations. Structure and precision are essential — you follow the set steps, use the right template, and log everything correctly (in Shopify and our Refund and Tracker document).



What you'll do:

- Work through the inbox every morning, replying within our response-time targets (within 4 hours on weekdays, 24 hours max).

- Check open/at-risk orders daily (e.g. missing addresses, stuck shipments) and pick these up proactively, even before the customer complains.

- Look up orders in Shopify to figure out exactly what's going on and what we can do to help the customer.

- Handle customer queries per our SOP — order status, fit, technical, and warranty issues.

- Process returns and exchanges carefully following the set steps, including accurate logging in the Refund and Tracker document.

- Coordinate closely with our supplier (via Slack, in English) and with management on escalations, refunds, and warranty decisions.

- Ensure a clear handover to the afternoon team so ongoing cases run smoothly.

- Over time: learn to recognize, log, and (eventually) help handle disputes and chargebacks independently.





Who we're looking for:

- Precise and structured — you follow procedures closely and never skip a step.

- Excellent written Dutch — all customer communication is in Dutch, with a warm, formal tone suited to an older audience.

- English is needed for coordinating with our supplier.

- Patient and empathetic, with genuine affinity for working with senior customers.

- Independent, but you know when to escalate — you'd rather ask than guess.

- Prior customer service experience, ideally in
 support.

- Nice to have: experience handling disputes/chargebacks, or strong interest in eventually taking this on.

- Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and quick to learn tools like Shopify and Slack.

title: Accounting Assistant
description:
Location: Fully Remote

Position Type: Part Time - Independent Contractor

Hours: 5-10 hours/week  (note: HQ in Irvine, CA- Pacific Time Zone preferred)

Compensation: Commensurate with experience

Reports To: Director of Operations

Compensation: $8/hour



About Us

The Black Girls Mental Health Foundation (BGMHF) is a nonprofit dedicated to eliminating mental health disparities through culturally responsive, trauma-informed care. Our work bridges the gap between perinatal mental health care and racial equity by connecting BIPOC birthing individuals, particularly Black mothers, to high-quality mental health services, trusted providers, and community-rooted support networks.



Together with our sister organization, the Black Girls Mental Health Collective, we deliver direct clinical services, train birth and mental health professionals, and advocate for systemic transformation. Our flagship initiative, the BIRTH Network, has supported over 127 families and provided more than 660 hours of culturally affirming therapy to date. With over 30 years of collective experience, our leadership team brings both research expertise and lived experience to the forefront of maternal mental health advocacy.



Position Overview

The Accounting Assistant supports the financial operations of Black Girls Mental Health Foundation (BGMHF) and Black Girls Mental Health Collective, Inc. (BGMHC), maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring staff and contractors are paid accurately and on time. This is a remote, detail-oriented role suited to someone comfortable working independently while coordinating closely with the Operations team.



Primary Responsibilities

- Maintain and reconcile day-to-day financial records in QuickBooks, including income, expenses, and vendor transactions.

- Categorize and code transactions accurately, keeping the chart of accounts organized and up to date.

- Run bi-weekly payroll reports and coordinate with the HR/ Operations team to ensure timely, accurate payroll processing.

- Reconcile bank and credit card statements against QuickBooks records on a regular schedule.

- Process and track vendor invoices, reimbursements, and accounts payable/receivable.

- Support month-end and year-end close processes, including preparation of basic financial reports.

- Maintain organized digital records of receipts, invoices, and supporting financial documentation.

- Flag discrepancies, duplicate charges, or irregularities for review by the Operations Lead.

- Assist with budget tracking for grants, events, and programs as needed.

- Support preparation of documentation for audits, tax filings, or grant reporting requests.

- Other duties as assigned.



Ideal Candidate Profile



Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience with QuickBooks (Online preferred); QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification a plus.

- Prior experience running or supporting payroll processes, including bi-weekly payroll cycles.

- Strong attention to detail and comfort working with numbers and financial records.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment and meet recurring deadlines.

- Discretion in handling confidential financial and personnel information.

- Experience supporting a nonprofit or small organization's finances is a plus.

- Familiarity with grant or program-based budget tracking is a plus.



Preferred Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance 

- 2+ years of accounting experience in a professional setting 

- Sharp attention to detail and strong analytical instincts 

- Looks for way to improve a process not just run it 

- Takes ownership and follows through

- Comfortable with constant collaboration 

- Excellent communication skills



Work Environment & Contractor Terms

This is a fully remote position. The Accounting Assistant must have a reliable internet connection, a private workspace suitable for handling confidential financial information, and the ability to meet recurring bi-weekly payroll deadlines.



CONFIDENTIALITY

This role requires access to sensitive financial and personnel information. The Accounting Assistant must maintain strict confidentiality regarding payroll, vendor, and organizational financial matters at all times.



How to Apply

Please
 your resume, brief portfolio (or examples of prior work), and a one-paragraph cover note to 
 with the subject line: Accounting Assistant Application – [Your Name]. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis through July 2026.

title: Sales Strategist
description:
About the Role



Root Pages is a growing digital marketing agency that helps small businesses strengthen their online presence and generate more leads. Our most popular offering is an affordable, subscription-based website design and management service with no setup fee, no long-term contract, and ongoing support.



We currently generate new business through an established outbound sales funnel. We are now looking to improve that process, diversify our sales channels, and create additional sources of predictable revenue.



This role will help develop and test new sales strategies while also managing the complete sales cycle, from identifying and contacting prospects through qualification, follow-up, closing, and onboarding handoff.



This is a collaborative, hands-on position. It is not a purely advisory role. The successful candidate must be equally comfortable developing sales strategies and personally executing them through daily prospecting, outreach, sales conversations, follow-ups, and closing.



As the company and sales operation grow, this position will offer opportunities for increased compensation, responsibility, and advancement.



Key Responsibilities

Sales Strategy and Development

Review our current sales funnel and recommend opportunities for improvement

Research and test new customer acquisition channels beyond our existing outreach

Develop ideal customer profiles, buyer personas, and industry-specific targeting strategies

Identify promising industries, geographic markets, referral sources, and partnership opportunities

Design and test outbound campaigns through cold
, LinkedIn, social media, direct outreach, partnerships, referrals, and other appropriate channels

Create and improve outreach messages, sales scripts, offers, follow-up sequences, and sales cadences

Explore strategies for referrals, partnerships, upsells, and reactivating previous leads

Conduct structured sales experiments and document the results

Help turn successful strategies into repeatable, documented sales processes



Full-Cycle Sales

Research prospects and build accurate, high-quality lead lists

Perform consistent daily prospecting and outbound outreach

Respond promptly and professionally to interested prospects

Qualify leads based on their needs, budget, authority, and readiness to move forward

Build relationships with prospects through consultative sales conversations

Book and conduct discovery calls, sales calls, and service demonstrations

Clearly explain our services, pricing, process, and value

Recommend the most appropriate service based on each prospect’s needs

Create and deliver proposals or follow-up information when needed

Address questions, concerns, and sales objections

Maintain consistent follow-up until the prospect makes a decision

Ask for the sale and guide qualified prospects through the signup process

Close new business and ensure a smooth handoff to the onboarding and service teams

Follow up with previous leads and pursue appropriate reactivation opportunities

Maintain accurate CRM records, notes, follow-up tasks, and pipeline stages

Reporting and Optimization

Track outreach activity, responses, appointments, proposals, close rates, and collected revenue

Maintain an accurate and up-to-date sales pipeline

Analyze performance to determine which audiences, messages, offers, and channels produce the best results

Share findings, successful approaches, and lessons learned with the sales team

Participate in regular sales meetings and pipeline reviews

Use performance data to continuously improve prospecting, qualification, follow-up, and closing



Performance Expectations



During the first 90 days, the Sales Strategist should:



Develop a strong understanding of our services, pricing, customers, and sales process

Collaborate effectively with our existing Sales Strategist and company leadership

Consistently perform daily prospecting, outreach, and follow-up activities

Manage assigned prospects through the complete sales cycle

Conduct effective discovery calls, demonstrations, and sales conversations

Review the current funnel and identify practical opportunities for improvement

Recommend and begin testing additional customer acquisition channels

Improve targeting, messaging, follow-up, qualification, and closing approaches

Maintain accurate CRM records and pipeline reporting

Begin independently generating and closing qualified sales opportunities



Long-term success will include:



Consistent generation of qualified sales opportunities

Regular achievement of agreed-upon sales and activity targets

Measurable growth in new customers and collected revenue

Strong follow-up discipline and effective pipeline management

Improved response, appointment, conversion, and close rates

Reduced dependence on a single customer acquisition channel

Effective collaboration and knowledge-sharing within the sales team

Repeatable sales systems that can be expanded as the company grows

Qualifications

Proven experience in full-cycle sales, outbound sales, business development, or sales strategy

Demonstrated experience moving prospects from initial outreach through closing

Strong prospecting, qualification, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills

Experience developing and testing new sales approaches

Experience creating outbound campaigns and prospecting systems

Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Comfortable initiating conversations, handling rejection, overcoming objections, and asking for the sale

Able to communicate value without relying on aggressive or high-pressure tactics

Persistent and consistent with follow-up while remaining professional

Able to analyze sales data and make decisions based on results

Collaborative, receptive to feedback, and comfortable sharing ownership

Highly organized and capable of independently managing a sales pipeline

Familiarity with CRM platforms, lead-generation tools, video meetings, and sales automation

Experience selling digital marketing, websites, subscriptions, or other business services is strongly preferred

Experience helping a small business or agency diversify its sales channels is a major advantage

Compensation



PHP 420–PHP 630 per hour, depending on experience, demonstrated capability, and previous results.



This is a part-time position of approximately 20 hours per week



Compensation will be reviewed as the company grows and the employee takes on greater responsibility. High performers will have opportunities for increased compensation and advancement.



Work Arrangement

Full-time remote position

Philippines-based candidates preferred

Long-term opportunity with advancement potential

Regular collaboration with our existing Sales Strategist and company leadership

Regular availability during agreed-upon U.S. business hours to communicate with prospects and conduct sales calls

Reliable computer, internet connection, webcam, and professional remote workspace required

Why Join Root Pages?

We Value You and Your Time



We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, respected, and trusted. We encourage a healthy work-life balance while maintaining clear expectations and accountability.



Paid Time Off and Holidays

12 paid Philippine holidays

1 paid company holiday

11 flexible paid vacation days, accrued over time

7 paid sick days, accrued over time

Flexible Scheduling



We understand that life sometimes requires flexibility. With advance notice and manager approval, we accommodate reasonable schedule adjustments while ensuring prospects and team responsibilities are covered.



Support During Extreme Weather



During severe weather events, we work with team members to support their safety, families, and employment stability.



Meaningful Growth Opportunity



This role offers long-term advancement potential as the company expands its sales operation. High performers may take on greater responsibility for developing new channels, improving sales systems, and supporting future sales team members.



How to Apply

title: GoHighLevel Audit & Fix — Real Estate CRM | One-Time Project
description:
Overview

I'm a licensed real estate agent and active investor in Oklahoma City running my business on GoHighLevel. My CRM has been built out over time but it's not working correctly — workflows are misfiring, texts are going out at the wrong times, names and contact information are getting mixed up, and I've had to turn off my automations entirely to stop the damage.

I need someone to come in, audit what's broken, fix it, and make sure everything is simple and functional before I turn it back on. Think Follow Up Boss simplicity — clean, intuitive, easy to operate daily without overthinking it. That's the standard I'm holding this to.

This is a one-time project with a fixed budget. I'm not looking for someone to over-engineer anything. Simple and functional is the goal.



WHAT WENT WRONG — SPECIFIC ISSUES TO FIX:



Workflows sending texts at wrong times of day — outside business hours

Contact names and information mixing up across leads

Automations not firing in the correct sequence

General workflow logic errors causing more harm than good

Everything is currently turned OFF — needs to be audited and rebuilt correctly before going live again





SCOPE OF WORK:

Phase 1 — Audit:



Review entire GHL setup — pipelines, workflows, automations, nurture sequences, tags, forms, and contact fields

Identify exactly what's broken and why

Deliver a simple written report — what you found, what caused it, what you recommend

We review and approve before you touch anything



Phase 2 — Fix and Rebuild:



Fix broken workflow logic

Rebuild nurture sequences — text,
, and manual task mix

Set correct sending windows — business hours only, CST

Fix contact field mapping so names and information pull correctly

Clean up pipeline stages and tags

Ensure lead sources route correctly into the right pipelines

Test every workflow and sequence thoroughly before handoff





MY SETUP:



Two pipelines — Lead/Sales pipeline and Transaction pipeline

Lead sources: outbound cold calling agency, organic social media, and automated lead sourcing

Nurture sequences exist but are broken — need to be rebuilt correctly

Tags and contact fields exist but may have mapping errors

Goal: simple, clean, and fully functional — easy enough to hand off to a VA later





WHO I'M LOOKING FOR:



Proven GHL experience — not someone learning on my account

Real estate CRM experience strongly preferred — you need to understand the lead lifecycle from cold outreach to closed transaction

Strong attention to detail — you're working in a live CRM with real leads

Communicates clearly — tell me what you're doing before you do it

Fixes problems simply — if your solution is complicated, it's not the right solution

Has diagnosed and fixed broken GHL workflows before — not just built new ones





THIS IS NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF:



You've never troubleshot broken GHL workflows before

You only know how to build from scratch — not diagnose existing problems

You over-complicate simple problems

You need me to explain what a pipeline or workflow is

You build systems that only you can maintain





DELIVERABLES:



Written audit report before any changes are made

Fully fixed and tested GHL workflows and sequences

Correct sending windows — business hours only, no late night texts

Clean contact field mapping — no more name/info mixups

Brief Loom walkthrough video of what was changed and how it works

Handoff notes simple enough for a VA to follow



TO APPLY:

Tell me:



How long you've been working in GHL

Whether you have real estate experience specifically

One example of a broken GHL workflow you diagnosed and fixed — describe what was wrong and how you fixed it in plain English



Applications without a specific example of fixing a broken workflow will not be reviewed. I've had enough of things not working — I need someone who has been in the trenches and solved real problems, not just someone who can build clean from scratch.

title: Real Estate Loan Processor

*** PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING ***



Read this entire post — including the HOW TO APPLY section at the bottom — before you apply. Follow every instruction exactly. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed.



*****************************************



OVERVIEW

We are a U.S.-based private real estate lending company (short-term / hard-money loans). We are hiring a Loan Processor to manage borrower documents, keep loan files organized, coordinate closings, and help service active loans. You keep files complete, organized, and moving to closing — and keep funded loans on track afterward.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



File processing (pre-close)



- Collect and track all borrower documents; follow up on anything missing

- Maintain clean, organized digital loan files

- Keep loan pipeline stages updated in our systems

- Coordinate with borrowers, title companies, insurance, attorneys, brokers, and our underwriter

- Follow up on and help clear underwriting conditions prior to funding

- Track closing deadlines and payoff timelines

- Ensure loan files are complete prior to funding

- Coordinate signatures, closing scheduling, and funding



Active loan servicing (post-close)



- Administer construction/rehab draws (review expense lists and progress photos, coordinate disbursement)

- Follow up with borrowers on project progress and log a short monthly status note per active loan

- Keep active-loan files and pipeline current

- Flag issues early (late payments, delinquency, scope changes, insurance lapses)

- Provide weekly loan status updates



IDEAL CANDIDATE



- Experience with U.S. real estate loan processing or mortgage processing

- Hands-on experience using a loan management / mortgage software system

- Clear, confident spoken English — you will speak with U.S. borrowers and title companies by phone

- Comfortable following structured processes and checklists

- Organized and deadline-driven; able to juggle multiple active files

- Comfortable learning new software quickly



Bonus:



- Experience with private lenders or short-term real estate loans

- Experience using CRM or pipeline-management tools



SCHEDULE



- Remote

- Part-time to start (about 5–6 hours per week) on a standby basis, growing into a full-time role as loan volume increases

- Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with U.S. business hours



COMPENSATION



- Flat monthly compensation, part-time / on-standby to start, with a clear path to full-time as volume grows

- Include your expected monthly rate in your application



*** HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY ***

Start your application with: Loan Ops Ready

Then record ONE short Loom video (2–3 minutes) that includes BOTH of these:



Borrower call role-play: Imagine I am a borrower calling you. My rehab draw has not funded yet, and your file notes show I sent my expense list but no progress photos. Respond to me the way you would on a real phone call.

Real file walk-through: Tell me about one real loan file you processed from start to closing — what you chased, what almost delayed it, and how you handled it.



Applications without the video, or that do not start with "Loan Ops Ready," will not be reviewed.

*****************************************

title: MUSIC TRANSCRIPTION SPECIALIST (PIANO SHEET MUSIC)
description:
Remote | Gig / Project-Based Position



Flat Fee Per Song (Paid Per Minute of Music)



I am a music teacher looking for a talented musician who can listen to songs and accurately write them into printable piano sheet music for my students.



This is a GIG position.



There are no guaranteed hours.



Whenever I need a song transcribed, I will send you the audio or YouTube link, and you will create the sheet music.



ABOUT THE ROLE



Your job is to listen to a song and create accurate piano sheet music that can be used for teaching students.



This may include:



* Melody

* Rhythm

* Chords

* Left-hand accompaniment

* Proper key signature

* Time signature

* Clear notation

* Easy-to-read formatting



Most songs will be pop songs, worship songs, children's songs, movie songs, or other music commonly requested by piano students.



IMPORTANT



This is NOT a learn-on-the-job position.



Previous music transcription experience is REQUIRED.



You should already know how to:



* Identify notes by ear

* Write music notation

* Create clean sheet music

* Use music notation software such as MuseScore, Sibelius, Finale, or Dorico



DELIVERABLES



For each project, you must provide:



* Printable PDF sheet music

* Editable MuseScore (.mscz) file (preferred)

* Or editable Sibelius / Finale file if you use those programs



COMPENSATION



Payment is based on the length of the FINISHED MUSIC, not the amount of time you spend working.



Standard songs: approximately $2.50 per minute of music.



More difficult songs may be paid at a higher rate.



Minimum payment per project: $10.



Examples:



* 4-minute song = $10

* 5-minute song = $12.50

* 8-minute song = $20

* 12-minute song = $30



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE



* Strong musical ear

* Previous transcription experience

* Piano knowledge

* Attention to detail

* Able to create clean, professional-looking sheet music

* Reliable and responsive

* Comfortable working independently



BONUS SKILLS



* Ability to simplify songs for beginners

* Ability to create easy/intermediate/advanced versions

* Ability to transpose songs into different keys

* Experience teaching piano

* Experience arranging music for students



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through the OnlineJobs.ph platform.



Please include:



* A short introduction

* What instruments you play

* What notation software you use

Commission on sales you generate. Our creators generate significant monthly revenue. Top-performing tea
mbers who consistently drive sales and build strong fan relationships earn well beyond base pay. How much you earn is directly tied to how good you are.

Your typing speed in WPM (test for free at 
 and include your result)

description:
# Real Estate Content & Marketing Virtual Assistant



**Remote — Philippines | 20–40 Hours per Week | $8 USD per Hour**



## About the Role



Andrew Freed is a multifamily real estate investor, real estate agent, podcast host, and community builder. We are hiring a creative, organized, and proactive Virtual Assistant to help manage and grow his personal brand.



This role combines **content creation, video editing, social media management, podcast support, event coordination, and real estate marketing**. The ideal candidate can take raw ideas, videos, voice notes, property updates, and podcast content and turn them into polished marketing assets.



## Key Responsibilities



### Content Creation and Editing



* Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts.

* Create podcast clips, captions, hooks, thumbnails, carousels, quote graphics, and educational posts.

### Social Media Management

, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok.

* Add captions, hashtags, tags, links, thumbnails, and calls to action.

* Monitor comments and direct messages and route important inquiries to the correct tea
mber.

* Track basic analytics, identify high-performing topics, and recommend new content ideas.

### Podcast Support



* Help identify and research potential podcast guests.

* Coordinate guest outreach, scheduling, reminders, and follow-up.

* Collect guest biographies, headshots, social links, and promotional materials.

* Prepare basic guest briefing documents and interview questions.

* Create episode titles, descriptions, show notes, timestamps, social captions, and promotional clips.

* Send guests completed marketing assets when their episodes are published.

### Monthly Real Estate Meetup



* Help coordinate Andrew’s monthly real estate meetup.

* Contact and schedule speakers, panelists, sponsors, and guests.

* Collect speaker headshots, biographies, topics, and presentation materials.

* Create event graphics, social media posts,
 announcements, registration materials, and reminder communications.

* Track registrations and maintain attendee lists.

* Create post-event recaps, photos, short videos, and follow-up content.

* Follow up with speakers, sponsors, and attendees after the event.



### Off-Market Property Marketing



* Create professional marketing materials for off-market real estate opportunities.

* Develop property flyers, one-page summaries, social graphics,
 campaigns, and presentation decks.

* Organize property photos, rent rolls, financial details, maps, and investment highlights.

* Verify that addresses, pricing, rents, contact information, and property details are accurate before publication.

* Coordinate with Andrew and the real estate team to obtain missing information.

* Prepare materials for social media,
 lists, investor groups, and direct buyer outreach.

* Maintain a tracker of available, upcoming, under-contract, and sold properties.



### Project and Team Coordination



* Track assignments, approvals, deadlines, and outstanding items.

* Follow up when materials or deliverables are late.

* Turn meetings and voice notes into organized tasks and action items.

* Maintain shared folders and keep files clearly labeled and easy to locate.

* Provide a concise weekly report covering:



  * Content published

  * Content in production

  * Upcoming podcast episodes

  * Meetup status

  * Property-marketing projects

  * Missed deadlines or bottlenecks

  * Items requiring Andrew’s approval

## Required Qualifications



* Strong written and spoken English.

* Experience creating and editing social media content.

* Video editing experience using CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Descript, or similar software.

* Strong Canva and presentation-design skills.

* Experience managing
, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, or YouTube.
