title: Direct Response Creative Strategist
description:
We are looking for a highly analytical and creative Direct Response Creative Strategist to develop advertising concepts that drive measurable sales for a fast-growing ecommerce brand.



This is not a traditional branding or social media role. Your primary responsibility will be to understand our customers, identify persuasive marketing angles, and turn those insights into clear creative concepts that our copywriters, video editors, designers, and content creators can execute.



The ideal candidate understands how to combine customer psychology, market research, creative storytelling, and performance data to consistently produce winning advertisements.



Key Responsibilities

Creative Strategy and Concept Development

Develop direct-response advertising concepts for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, native advertising, and other paid media platforms.

Create clear creative briefs for video ads, static ads, advertorials, landing pages, and user-generated content.

Develop new hooks, angles, scripts, headlines, offers, and storytelling frameworks.

Translate product features into persuasive customer benefits and emotionally compelling messaging.

Identify customer pain points, objections, desires, fears, and buying motivations.

Create variations of winning concepts to extend their performance and prevent creative fatigue.

Customer and Market Research

Conduct deep research using customer reviews, surveys, competitor advertisements, Reddit, Amazon reviews, social media comments, support tickets, and other customer feedback.

Build and maintain detailed customer avatars and awareness-level profiles.

Analyze competitor positioning, messaging, offers, funnels, landing pages, and creative strategies.

Identify emerging trends, market opportunities, and underused advertising angles.

Creative Production Management

Provide detailed briefs and direction to copywriters, designers, video editors, content creators, and UGC talent.

Clearly communicate the hook, angle, audience, desired emotion, visual direction, and call to action for each concept.

Review creative drafts and provide actionable feedback before advertisements are launched.

Ensure advertisements remain consistent with the brand while prioritizing performance and conversion.

Coordinate with the creative team to maintain a reliable production schedule.

Performance Analysis

Work closely with media buyers to understand which concepts, hooks, formats, and audiences are performing.

Review creative performance using metrics such as thumb-stop rate, hold rate, click-through rate, conversion rate, cost per acquisition, return on ad spend, and creative spend.

Identify why advertisements succeeded or failed and apply those learnings to future concepts.

Maintain a structured creative testing system and document key findings.

Develop iterations based on data rather than personal preference.

What We Are Looking For

Proven experience developing direct-response creative for an ecommerce or direct-to-consumer brand.

Strong understanding of consumer psychology, persuasion, offers, and purchasing behaviour.

Experience creating concepts for products that require education, demonstration, or strong problem-solution messaging.

Ability to write compelling hooks, scripts, headlines, and creative briefs.

Strong understanding of Meta advertising and short-form video creative.

Experience analyzing performance data and turning findings into creative decisions.

Ability to distinguish between attractive creative and creative that generates profitable sales.

Strong research, communication, organization, and project-management skills.

Ability to work independently while collaborating with media buyers and creative-production teams.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with frequent testing and iteration.

Preferred Experience

Experience working with health, wellness, beauty, supplement, personal-care, or other high-growth ecommerce brands.

Experience with advertorials, long-form sales pages, VSLs, native advertising, and conversion-focused landing pages.

Familiarity with tools such as Meta Ads Library, Motion, Foreplay, CapCut, Google Drive, Slack, ClickUp, or similar platforms.

Experience managing UGC creators, editors, designers, or copywriters.

Familiarity with advertising compliance and avoiding unsupported or overly aggressive claims.

Experience scaling brands through high-volume creative testing.

Key Performance Indicators



Your performance may be evaluated based on:



Number of high-quality creative concepts delivered.

Percentage of concepts launched and tested.

Improvement in click-through rate and conversion rate.

Number of winning or scalable advertisements produced.

Reduction in creative fatigue.

Creative testing velocity.

Quality and clarity of creative briefs.

Ability to generate meaningful iterations from performance data.

Contribution to customer-acquisition cost and return-on-ad-spend targets.

What Success Looks Like



Within your first 30 days, you will understand our products, customers, competitors, current advertisements, and creative-production process.



Within 60 days, you will be consistently delivering research-backed concepts and briefs that the creative team can execute efficiently.



Within 90 days, you will have established a repeatable testing system, identified new scalable angles, and contributed to advertisements that improve customer acquisition and revenue.

title: Finance & Bookkeeping Specialist (Remote) — Casa Oso, near Yosemite
description:
About us



Casa Oso is a small collection of thoughtfully hosted homes in the Sierra Nevada mountains of California, near Yosemite. We're a small, close team that cares about doing things properly — for our guests and behind the scenes. This role keeps our finances accurate, organized, and on time, so the rest of the team can focus on hosting.



The role



You'll be the person who keeps Casa Oso's books clean and our finances clear. It's remote, part-time contractor work, with real room to grow as we do. You'll own the bookkeeping and bring a sharp eye to the numbers — spotting what's off, keeping us compliant, and helping us understand how each property is really doing.



A week in this role looks like:





Keeping the books in QuickBooks — reconciling bank and card accounts, entering invoices and receipts, and flagging anything that looks off

Reviewing incoming and outgoing payments (were the cleaning, pet, and insurance fees charged correctly?) and approving payouts against invoices and contracts

Preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual reports — revenue, costs, and KPIs per property — plus simple budgets

Handling tax and compliance filings (county lodging/TOT taxes, 1099s and W-2s, Franchise Tax Board, property taxes) and keeping our documentation tidy

Managing payment processors (Stripe, Airbnb, 
) and supporting payroll, insurance, and licensing/registration tracking





Who we hope to meet





At least 2 years of bookkeeping experience in the vacation rental / short-term rental industry

Confident in QuickBooks

Able to do real financial analysis — not just record the numbers, but read them

A higher-education background in finance, business, accounting, math, law, or similar

Organized, precise, discreet with sensitive information, and comfortable working independently





A few practical things (worth a read before you apply)





This is independent contractor work. You'll need to be — or be happy to become — a registered self-employed individual in the Philippines, with a TIN and a BIR Certificate of Registration, and you'll look after your own taxes.

It's a part-time role — around 20 hours a week — with hours we agree together, paid as a fixed monthly salary, with a warm review after your first six months.

You'll work from your own reliable computer and internet.

Most of all, we're hoping to find someone who'd like to grow with us for the long run.





A little exercise (this is how we get to know you)



One quick, real-world one for us. We pass our booking-platform commission on to guests through a markup on the nightly rate.





If a platform takes 15% of the total price the guest pays, and we want to still net our full base nightly rate, what markup do we need to add to the base rate to cover the commission fully?







Show your working (a $200 base rate is fine to illustrate). And please put your answer — the markup, as a single percentage — on the very first line of your reply.



How to apply



Reply here on OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line: Casa Oso Finance Specialist — [Your Name], and include:





Your answer to the exercise above — with the markup percentage on your very first line, and your working below it

Your expected pay in USD — an hourly rate or a monthly rate for part-time (~20 hrs/week), whichever feels right to you

The hours and days you can comfortably commit to, and your time zone

A little about your relevant experience (especially vacation-rental bookkeeping and QuickBooks), with your resume/CV

A quick note confirming you're registered — or willing to register — as a self-employed contractor with a TIN and BIR Certificate of Registration





We read every complete application, and we'd genuinely love to meet you.

title: SEO Content Writer & Editor (AI-Assisted)
description:
Why You’ll Love This Role



If you’re the kind of writer who enjoys transforming good content into exceptional content, thrives on research, and takes pride in producing work that genuinely helps readers, this may be the opportunity you’ve been looking for.



This is not a traditional content writing position.



At E-Marketing Associates, we provide detailed article briefs that include the topic, target keyword, search intent, internal links, calls to action, semantic keywords, and editorial direction. We also provide a proven AI-assisted workflow that streamlines the writing process.



Your role isn’t simply to generate content. It’s to research, verify, refine, and elevate AI-assisted drafts into engaging, accurate, publication-ready articles that readers trust and search engines reward.



If you enjoy improving AI-generated content rather than starting every article from a blank page, you’ll feel right at home here.



---



Long-Term Opportunity



This is a long-term opportunity with the potential to grow into a full-time position.



We value quality over quantity and are looking for someone who takes pride in producing exceptional content, enjoys learning, and wants to build a lasting career with our team.



As our agency continues to grow, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills in SEO, AI Visibility, content strategy, and editorial excellence while becoming an integral part of our content production team.



---



About E-Marketing Associates



E-Marketing Associates is a California-based digital marketing agency that has been helping businesses grow online since 1999.



We specialize in SEO, websites, AI Visibility, local search, and content marketing for service-based businesses across the United States.



Our mission is simple: help our customers become the trusted authority in their market through exceptional digital marketing, educational content, and measurable business results.



---



Our Writing Philosophy



We believe the best content is created by people who know how to combine AI efficiency with human expertise.



AI is an exceptional productivity tool, but it is not a replacement for human judgment.



Our writers are editors, researchers, and problem solvers.



We expect every writer to:



* Verify facts before publication.

* Research topics using reliable sources.

* Improve AI-generated drafts through thoughtful editing.

* Eliminate repetitive or generic language.

* Add clarity, context, and practical value.

* Apply sound editorial judgment.

* Follow detailed SEO and AI Visibility guidelines.

* Deliver content that provides significantly more value than a basic AI-generated response.



The finished article should read naturally, build trust with the reader, and be ready for publication.



---



What You’ll Do



* Research assigned topics using reliable sources.

* Use our AI-assisted writing workflow to generate article outlines and first drafts.

* Verify facts, statistics, technical information, and claims before publication.

* Rewrite and improve AI-generated content.

* Follow detailed editorial and SEO briefs.

* Write engaging introductions and compelling conclusions.

* Naturally incorporate internal links and calls to action.

* Produce polished, publication-ready articles requiring minimal revisions.

* Meet deadlines while maintaining exceptional quality.



---



What We’re Looking For



* Outstanding written English.

* Excellent grammar, spelling, and proofreading skills.

* Experience writing SEO blog articles.

* Comfortable using ChatGPT or similar AI tools as part of your writing process.

* Strong research skills.

* Ability to simplify complex topics for everyday readers.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to follow detailed instructions.

* Dependable and organized.

* Willingness to continually learn new SEO and AI Visibility strategies.



---



Preferred Qualifications



* Professional SEO content writing experience.

* Understanding of search intent and topical authority.

* Experience writing for service-based businesses.

* Ability to quickly learn unfamiliar industries.

* Experience writing educational, long-form content.



---



What to Expect During Our Hiring Process



We’re looking for someone who wants to build a long-term relationship with our team, so we’ve designed a hiring process that gives both of us the opportunity to determine whether we’re a great fit.



Step 1: Application Review



We’ll carefully review your resume, writing samples, AI experience, and attention to detail, including whether you’ve followed all application instructions.



Step 2: Video Interview



Selected candidates will be invited to a 20-30 minute video interview where we’ll discuss your experience, your writing process, how you use AI, and what you’re looking for in your next opportunity.



Step 3: Paid Writing Assignment



Finalists will complete a paid writing assignment based on one of our actual customer article briefs. Every finalist receives the same assignment so we can fairly evaluate writing quality, research ability, editorial judgment, organization, attention to detail, and your ability to improve AI-generated content.



Step 4: Final Interview



We’ll review your writing assignment together, discuss your editorial decisions, answer any remaining questions, and determine whether we’re the right fit for each other.



Step 5: Welcome to the Team



If selected, we’ll introduce you to our editorial workflow, AI-assisted writing process, and content standards so you can begin contributing with confidence.



---



To Apply



Please include:



* Your resume.

* Two or three SEO blog articles you personally wrote.

* A brief description of your experience using AI writing tools.

* Your favorite productivity tool and why you enjoy using it.



**Important:** To help us identify applicants who pay close attention to detail, please include the words **“Red Elephant”** in the subject line of your application. Applications that do not include **“Red Elephant”** will not be considered.



**One more request:** Please do not use AI to write your application. You’re welcome to use AI as an editing tool, but we want to hear your authentic voice. Your application should reflect your own communication style, professionalism, and attention to detail.



If you’re excited about the future of AI-assisted content creation and believe great writing still requires human expertise, we’d love to hear from you.



Mitch Woolley

Founder & CEO

E-Marketing Associates

title: Performance Video Editor | Remote | Fast-Growing DTC Health Brand
description:
Performance Video Editor | Remote | Fast-Growing DTC Health Brand



We usually respond to thoughtful applications within one business day.



We are hiring video editor(s) for a fast-growing DTC health brand building a serious performance creative team.



This is not a basic editing role.



We are looking for an editor who understands attention, pacing, retention, storytelling, hooks, product trust, and direct-response creative. Someone who can take a brief, a reference, raw assets, and real-world constraints, then turn them into a clean ad that is actually ready to launch.



If you are a top-tier editor, you probably already know your worth.



Good. We want people with taste, speed, ownership, and the confidence to communicate clearly when something can be better.



ROLE DETAILS



- Remote / worldwide

- Fast-paced performance creative team

- Short-form ads, UGC-style ads, VSL-style creatives, product videos, hooks, and cutdowns

- Long-term growth path for people who perform



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Edit launch-ready paid social ads for Meta, TikTok, Reels, and other platforms

- Build strong hooks, cutdowns, variations, and performance-focused edits

- Improve pacing, clarity, retention, captions, visual rhythm, and CTA flow

- Review briefs, references, assets, and notes before cutting

- Catch issues before final export: wrong products, bad audio, weak clips, awkward cuts, off-sync captions, missing assets, or anything that makes the ad feel unlaunchable

- Suggest better creative decisions when you see a stronger path

- Communicate early when something is unclear, broken, late, or needs a better solution



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You might be a fit if you have:



- Strong editing taste and visual judgment

- Sharp pacing, retention, and storytelling instincts

- Experience with short-form ads, UGC, ecommerce, YouTube, VSLs, or creator content

- Strong English comprehension

- Good attention to detail

- A fast but careful editing workflow

- Comfort using AI tools or willingness to learn fast

- Clear communication and high ownership

- The ability to follow references closely without losing your own creative taste



Experience with ecommerce, DTC, health, wellness, direct-response, or paid ads is a major plus.



But if your work is strong and your fundamentals are sharp, apply anyway. Proof beats pedigree here.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



A lot of editing roles treat editors like button-pushers.



This one does not.



We want creative operators: people who can think, execute, catch mistakes, improve the final product, and help raise the creative standard over time.



The right person can grow into higher-responsibility roles like Senior Editor, Lead Editor, Creative Strategist, UGC Manager, or Creative Lead as the team grows.



This is a long-term role at a long-term company. We are building for years, not weeks.



HOW WE OPERATE



Quality first. Speed second. Communication always.



We prefer early communication over silence. If something is unclear, broken, missing, late, or likely to hurt the final ad, say it early.



No fake corporate theater. No ego games. No disappearing when something gets hard.



We want direct, practical, hungry people who care about making the creative win.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



- Competitive compensation based on skill, reliability, and output

- Remote work

- Long-term growth path

- Real ownership and autonomy

- Direct feedback that makes you better

- Mentorship and investment in your creative, technical, and strategic growth

- Additional benefits can be discussed based on your needs



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:





Do not send a generic copy-paste message.



Fill out the form properly. Include your best work, editing examples, tools, availability, and a clear breakdown of why one of your edits worked.



At the end of the form, write LFG so we know you read everything.



Thoughtful applications are usually reviewed within one business day.

 Required Qualifications

* Strong understanding of database backups, schemas, migrations, and access control

* Knowledge of website security and administrator access management

* Experience with technical SEO and website performance optimization

* Ability to document systems clearly for nontechnical business owners

Ownership and Security Requirements



The developer must agree that:

* All source code, databases, configurations, documentation, credentials, and project assets created or managed during the engagement belong exclusively to our company.

* All production accounts must be created under company-controlled
 addresses.

title: K-12 Virtual Tutors
description:
About Spark Xplorer



Spark Xplorer is a K–12 tutoring program supporting U.S.-based scholars with personalized, one-on-one and small-group learning. We currently have an established team of tutors, and we're now growing our global tutor network by recruiting a small, high-quality cohort of tutors based in the Philippines. This is a chance to get in early on a program that rewards strong performance with more hours as it scales.



About the Role



We're looking for qualified, reliable, and engaging online tutors to teach U.S. K–12 scholars in Math, English Language Arts (ELA), and/or Science. You'll work alongside our existing tutor team as part of one Spark Xplorer Global Tutor Network, delivering sessions aligned to each scholar's personalized learning plan.



We're hiring across a few different profiles — you don't need to fit all of them:





K–5 Elementary — Math and ELA

Grades 6–8 — Math and/or ELA

Grades 6–12 — Math

Grades 6–12 — Science or another high-demand specialist subject





Tutors who can competently teach multiple subjects or grade levels are especially valued.



What You'll Do



Deliver online tutoring sessions to U.S. K–12 scholars following Spark Xplorer's personalized curriculum and weekly learning plans

Explain concepts clearly, adapt your teaching style to each student, and keep sessions engaging

Track and report on session progress using Spark Xplorer's systems and approved tools

Maintain professional, appropriate communication with minors and their parents at all times

Complete required training, assessments, and ongoing performance check-ins





What We're Looking For





Strong spoken and written English, with clear and easily understandable communication

Experience teaching or tutoring K–12 students (online tutoring experience is a plus)

Comfort with U.S.-based students; familiarity with U.S. curriculum/Common Core is an advantage but not required — strong subject knowledge and teaching ability matter most, and we provide training

Experience working with children, and genuine enjoyment of teaching them

Reliable internet connection, a functional computer with working camera/microphone, and a quiet, professional teaching space

Backup internet and backup power arrangements (recommended, given regional outages)

Availability during U.S. teaching hours

Comfortable using video conferencing, screen sharing, digital whiteboards, Google Docs, and online learning platforms





Prior experience with Zoom-based tutoring, ESL instruction, or Math/Science tutoring is a plus.



Compensation & Engagement





Pay: Approximately $5–$7 per teaching hour, based on subject certification and experience

Tutors join our available tutor pool; hours are not fixed initially and grow based on scholar demand, availability, and performance

A 60-day initial review period applies to new tutors, starting with a limited caseload

High-performing tutors receive priority for additional sessions and hours as demand grows





Application Process



This is a multi-stage process to ensure a strong fit for our scholars:





Application form — background, education, experience, availability, and expected rate

Document submission — CV/resume, government-issued ID, relevant certificates, a short introductory video, an internet speed test, and professional references

Initial screening — HR review of qualifications, communication, and overall fit

Assessments — spoken English & instructional communication, subject knowledge test, and a short teaching audition

Vetting — identity verification, education/employment verification, reference checks, and a criminal background check (required, as this role involves working directly with minors)

Training & certification — completion of Spark Xplorer's tutor training program and final assessment





Only candidates who successfully complete all vetting and certification steps will be onboarded as Spark Xplorer Certified Tutors.



What to Submit



To apply, please prepare:





Your CV/resume

Education and teaching certificates (if applicable)

A short (2–3 minute) introductory video covering: who you are, subjects/grade levels you can teach, your teaching experience, why you enjoy teaching children, and why you're interested in Spark Xplorer

An internet speed test result

Contact details for at least two professional references







Spark Xplorer is committed to child safety. All tutors are required to complete identity verification, background screening, and child safeguarding training before being assigned to scholars.

title: Guest Experience Specialist (Remote Host) — Casa Oso, near Yosemite
description:
About us



Casa Oso is a small collection of thoughtfully hosted homes in the Sierra Nevada mountains of California, near Yosemite. We're not a big, impersonal operation — we take care of the details so our guests can settle in and simply enjoy their time together. The warmth in how we communicate is the heart of everything we do, and it's the most important thing we're looking for in this role.



The role



As one of our remote hosts, you're the friendly, reassuring voice our guests hear — before, during, and after their stay. It's remote, contractor work, and there's real room to grow with us.



A day in this role looks like:





Being there for guests, warmly and quickly, by message and by phone — across Airbnb, Vrbo, and 

Meeting the occasional bump — a lockout, a power outage, a wildfire watch near the park — with a calm, steady, we've-got-this presence

Working closely with our cleaning and maintenance team so every arrival feels just right

Keeping calendars, listings, details, and follow-ups tidy, so nothing slips

Quietly keeping things running behind the scenes — scheduling, guest claims, and our monitoring tools (cameras, smart locks, climate)





Who we hope to meet





Someone whose written English is natural and genuinely warm

Experience in hospitality, short-term rentals, or customer care (guest-facing is a lovely plus)

Reliable, organized, and comfortable thinking on your feet

A bonus if you already know Airbnb/Vrbo/Booking, or tools like Hostaway, Guesty, and Google Workspace





A few practical things (worth a read before you apply)





This is independent contractor work. You'll need to be — or be happy to become — a registered self-employed individual in the Philippines, with a TIN and a BIR Certificate of Registration, and you'll look after your own taxes.

We host guests from 8:00 AM to midnight (PST), every day, so our shifts run on a set schedule that can include some evenings, weekends, or holidays. We set your schedule together, and now and then we may need to adjust or reassign shifts as our coverage needs change.

It's a full-time role (around 40 hours a week), paid as a fixed monthly salary, with a warm review after your first six months.

You'll work from your own reliable computer and internet.

Most of all, we're hoping to find someone who'd like to grow with us for the long run.





A little exercise (this is how we get to know you)



Picture yourself hosting for us. A guest messages soon after checking in:





"Hi, we just checked in and the dining area wasn't clean — there are dirty dishes in the sink and crumbs on the table. Not the arrival we expected."







Write back exactly as you would to the guest.



How to apply



Reply here on OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line Casa Oso Remote Host — [Your Name], and include:





Your reply to the guest above

Your expected pay in USD — an hourly rate or a full-time monthly rate, whichever feels right to you

The hours and days you can comfortably commit to, and your time zone

A little about your relevant experience, with your resume/CV

A quick note confirming you're registered — or willing to register — as a self-employed contractor with a TIN and BIR Certificate of Registration





We read every complete application, and we'd genuinely love to meet you.

title: Quality Control/Delivery Specialist for Real Estate Media Company
description:
LOCATION: Remote

COMPANY: Crossgate Realty Media (South Carolina, United States)

JOB TYPE: Full Time (Tuesday - Saturday 12:00am – 9:00am EST with one hour for lunch / Initial training takes place during daytime EST hours)





ABOUT US

At Crossgate Realty Media, we help real estate agents and builders stand out by delivering consistent, high-quality listing photos and media. Our reputation is built on speed, accuracy, and reliability. As our volume continues to grow, we're looking to add another detail-oriented QC & Delivery Specialist to serve as the last line of defense before every order reaches our clients — catching problems, finishing what others started, and making sure nothing goes out the door unless it's right. 



This role is less about creative editing and more about completeness, accuracy, and follow-through. You'll do some hands-on editing in AutoHDR when needed, but your main job is reviewing full orders end-to-end, closing gaps, and packaging and delivering finished work our clients can trust.





QUICK REQUIREMENTS

Candidates must have a full screen monitor (21+ inches) and a reliably fast internet connection. If selected, part of the interviewing process includes showing an internet speed test during the call.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



-Final Quality Control-



Review each completed order in full before delivery — not just the edits, but the whole package: correct shot list, correct compositions, correct property, correct file counts.



Check listing photos processed through AutoHDR for exposure, white balance, color consistency, natural contrast, straight verticals, realistic window pulls, and realistic lawns/yards.



Catch missing shots, mismatched media, or inconsistencies before they ever reach the client — and know when "close enough" isn't good enough.



-Editing Corrections & Touch-Ups-



Make manual adjustments when AutoHDR edits are incorrect, inconsistent, or over-processed.



Correct common issues that arise from AI image processing.



Apply builder-specific touch-ups when applicable (ex: dirt cleanup, debris removal, grass fixes, appliance touch-ups).



Use ReImagine Home to process and refine builder exterior photos according to Crossgate standards.



-Packaging & Delivery-



Assemble final, client-ready packages in HD PhotoHub and deliver orders on time, every time.



Own an order until it's actually out the door — follow through on any open item rather than passing it along incomplete.



Communicate with the internal team immediately when an issue may affect delivery timing.



Escalate unusual or repeat problems to the Lead Editor or leadership when needed.



-Consistency & Standards-



Maintain consistent editing and delivery standards across all listings regardless of photographer or property type.



Follow Crossgate's established guidelines rather than personal creative preference.



Flag recurring issues so workflows and standards can keep improving.



-Workflow & Internal Coordination-



Work efficiently within our systems to keep turnaround times on track.



Collaborate effectively with a remote team across overlapping shifts.





WHO YOU ARE



You have Tenacity — you push things through to done. You don't let an order sit half-finished, and you're the person who closes the loop instead of leaving it open.



You have Discernment — you have a sharp, reliable sense for what's "good enough to send" and what isn't, and you trust that instinct even under volume and time pressure.



You have a sharp eye for detail and can quickly spot both editing issues and missing/incorrect content others may miss.

title: Google Ads & Conversion Tracking Specialist (Remote)
description:
#Google Ads & Conversion Tracking Specialist (Remote)



Are you the person everyone calls when Google Ads conversion tracking breaks?



Do you enjoy figuring out why conversions aren't firing, connecting data across multiple platforms, and building tracking systems that marketing teams can actually trust?



Trailzi is looking for a highly technical Google Ads & Conversion Tracking Specialist to help us build reliable tracking for our clients. This is not a campaign management role. While you'll need to understand Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, your primary responsibility will be ensuring every lead is tracked accurately from click to customer.



If you're passionate about attribution, analytics, and solving complicated tracking problems, we'd love to meet you.



## About Trailzi



Trailzi is a digital marketing agency that helps small businesses grow through SEO, paid advertising, websites, and marketing strategy. We believe good marketing starts with good data. If we can't measure results, we can't improve them.



We're looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges and building clean tracking systems that help both our clients and our team make smarter decisions.



## What You'll Do

* Build advanced attribution and conversion tracking across multiple platforms.

* Build tracking for forms, phone calls, chat widgets, appointment schedulers, and other lead sources.

* Configure offline conversion imports when appropriate.

* Implement Enhanced Conversions and first-party tracking solutions.

* Troubleshoot conversion discrepancies between platforms.

* Verify tracking accuracy before campaigns launch.

* Document tracking implementations so they can be maintained by the team.

* Stay current on privacy updates, consent mode, and tracking best practices.



## Platforms You'll Work With



Experience with several of these platforms is expected.



* Google Ads

* Microsoft Ads

* Google Tag Manager

* Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

* CallRail

* HubSpot

* Google Search Console

* Meta Pixel

* LinkedIn Insight Tag

* Microsoft Clarity

* Smart forms and dynamic content

* CRM integrations

* Landing page builders

* Zapier or similar automation tools



## What We're Looking For



You should have experience building complete conversion tracking systems—not simply installing a Google Ads tag.



The ideal candidate has:



* 3+ years of hands-on Google Ads implementation experience.

* Strong Google Tag Manager experience.

* Advanced GA4 knowledge.

* Experience with CallRail integrations.

* Experience configuring HubSpot marketing and sales attribution.

* Experience troubleshooting complex conversion issues.

* A strong understanding of attribution models.

* Experience tracking both online and offline conversions.

* Familiarity with consent mode, cookies, and modern privacy requirements.

* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

* Strong written English communication skills.



## Bonus Experience



These aren't required but would be a major advantage.

* Google Looker Studio

* BigQuery

* Call tracking implementations

* API-based conversion integrations

* CRM automation

* Marketing automation platforms

* WordPress development

## What Success Looks Like



Within your first few months, you'll be able to:

* Diagnose and fix broken conversion tracking quickly.

* Ensure every qualified lead is attributed correctly.

* Create documentation that other tea
mbers can follow.

* Help improve the quality of reporting across our agency.



## Pay



Compensation is based on experience and technical ability.



## How to Apply



We're looking for someone who pays attention to details.

1. Your resume.

2. A brief summary of the most technically challenging conversion tracking implementation you've completed.

title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
About EasyMate

EasyMate.ai helps small and medium-sized businesses use AI to automate customer-facing operations, from capturing leads to answering questions, following up, supporting customers, and growing revenue.

EasyMate is built for non-technical business owners who do not have large teams, expensive software systems, or technical expertise. EasyMate configures the right AI assistants and solutions for SMB owners based on their business problems. They don't have to learn AI.



The Role

We are looking for a Growth Marketing Specialist to own the entire demand side of the business -  everything from "who do we target" to "they paid." You are a hands-on data-driven operator, not a manager or strategist: you'll personally build the lists, send the
s, work the replies, and optimize the funnel. 

Working directly with the founder and GTM engineers, you will execute and optimize the campaigns that drive our growth. You’ll be expected to move fast, test aggressively, and iterate based on what the data tells us. No corporate fluff, just pure growth.



What You'll Own

- Targeting: Build and qualify prospect lists that fit our ICP (revenue-generating small-to-medium businesses). Experienced with tools like Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn, niche data sources and SEMrush/SpyFu.

- Outbound Mastery: Launch and manage cold
 sequences with "invisible" personalization copy so natural that a U.S. lead would never guess it was automated. Run the cold
 campaign end to end - write and test the messaging, manage sending domains/inboxes and deliverability (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, warmup, volume).

- Follow-up & conversion: Work every reply fast, send the checkout link, remove friction, get them to paid.

- Growth Lab: Run continuous A/B tests on subject lines, hooks, and CTAs to drive conversions.

- Funnel Optimization: Analyze campaign performance via GA4 and outbound dashboards to identify and fix leaks in the funnel. Track the full funnel (demos sent ? clicked ? replied ? paid), report weekly, and double down on what converts.

- Collaborative Iteration: Work with the founder and GTM engineer to update landing pages and funnels based on real-time market feedback.

- Channel testing: Once outbound works, run cheap tests on the next channels (communities, partnerships, referral).



What We're Looking For

Must-haves

- Experience: 2 - 4 years in digital marketing, growth hacking and lead generation (SaaS experience is a major plus).

- Tool Stack: Hands-on proficiency with 
, Apollo, Lemlist, Instantly, Clay, GA4, SemRush/SpyFu

- The "Invisible English" Factor: Your written English must be flawless. You can write persuasive, high-converting copy for a U.S. executive audience without it sounding "robotic" or "foreign."

- Data Literacy: You live in the metrics. You understand CAC, LTV, and conversion rates, and you know how to move them.

- Schedule: Based in Jakarta with reliable high-speed internet. You must be comfortable with a 4-hour overlap with U.S. Pacific Time (typical evening/night hours in Asia).

- Grit: You thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where you are expected to ship multiple experiments weekly.

- Full-time: This is a demanding position, and you need to dedicate 100% of your time to this role



Nice-to-haves

- Experience selling self-serve to prosumers/SMBs (coaches, home-services, creators, consultants, event planners, therapists etc).

- A track record of getting a startup its first 100 paying customers.

- Outbound automation experience



Who thrives here

- You can move fast without waiting for a perfect brief

- You think in systems, not one-off tasks

- You are data-driven and yet able to come up with creative experiments

- You're comfortable being the only person owning this function for now



Why Join EasyMate

- Ground-floor opportunity to define the growth playbook for an emerging AI product category

- Direct impact — your work will be one of our primary growth levers

- Async-friendly, remote team

- Work on a product that's genuinely novel (and fun to explain)

- Mentorship: Direct exposure to scaling an AI startup alongside the founder.

- Freedom: 100% remote work with a high-trust, results-only culture.

description:
Hi, my name is ADBABY! I am looking for a team of 5 to 10 hungry, talented video editors to clip my gaming and entertainment live streams and turn them into highly engaging vertical videos (TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels). This is a performance-based role where payouts are decided live on stream every week!



???? The Weekly Tiered Reward System



Every week, we will review the submitted clips live on stream (usually Sunday or Monday, any updates are in my Discord server). 



Payouts are determined by which view tier your video hits:



 Tier 1 (4,000+ views): £5 payout

 Tier 2 (7,500+ views): £10 payout

 Tier 3 (10,000+ views): £30 payout



The Top-Performer Multiplier



There is strictly one 1st Place winner and one 2nd Place winner chosen each week:



 1st Place (Highest Views overall): Receives 100% value of their achieved tier (up to £30).



 2nd Place (Runner-up): Receives 75% of their achieved tier value.



???? The Weekly Jackpot Rollover



If the algorithm is brutal and nobody hits the 4,000-view threshold (Tier 1) for 1st place, the top prize money rolls over to the following week. The top prize instantly doubles to £100 and keeps growing until someone cracks the algorithm (capped at a maximum of £150 total rollover budget for the month).



???? Submission & Verification Rules



To qualify for payouts, all editors must follow these guidelines:



1. Format: Clips must be edited into vertical format, include engaging captions, and be posted publicly.



2. Tagging: You must use the hashtag #adbaby and tag my official handle on the respective platform.



3. Account Age: Videos must be posted on channels/accounts that are at least 30 days old.



4. The "Cooking" Rule: To give the algorithm time to work, videos must be uploaded at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to the weekly review stream to be eligible for that week's payout.



5. Analytics Proof: Winners must provide a backend screenshot of their video analytics. Over 90% of the traffic must come from organic feeds (FYP, Shorts Feed, Reels Feed). Direct, external, or botted traffic will result in immediate disqualification.



????? Discretion, Terms, and Flexibility



Live Stream Review: All clips will be audited live on stream. Payouts are calculated strictly based on the view count at the exact time of the live review.



Final Discretion: While views are the primary metric, final winners are chosen at my individual discretion on stream to ensure quality. Spamming low-effort clips will not win, even if they accidentally get views.



Fraud Prevention: Any suspicion of view botting or artificial engagement will result in immediate termination from the team without pay.



Operational Flexibility: I reserve the right to pause, adjust, or restructure the payout system at any time depending on budget.



???? How to Apply

2. A Custom Sample (Highly Prioritised: Want to stand out and jump to the front of the queue? title: SPED Teacher / Maths Tutor for 11-Year-Old with ADHD (Fluent English, Long-Term, Ongoing)
description:
**SPED Teacher / Maths Tutor for 11-Year-Old with ADHD (Fluent English, Long-Term, Ongoing)**



We're a Sydney (Australia) family looking for a patient, skilled online maths tutor for our 11-year-old son. This is a long-term, ongoing role for the right person.



**The ideal profile (this is what we're looking for):**

- **Licensed SPED (Special Education) teacher** — this is our priority

- **Strong at teaching primary / early-secondary maths**, especially to children who struggle

- **Experience with ADHD children** — keeping an easily-distracted child engaged and on track

- **Clear, fluent spoken English** — essential, as our son has a speech delay and English is his second language (Spanish is spoken at home)



If you don't tick every box but you're a strong SPED teacher or a primary teacher with real experience helping struggling maths learners, we'd still like to hear from you.



**About our son:**

He is in Year 6 (NSW/Australian curriculum), friendly, hard-working and keen to do well. He has ADHD and a language impairment. Importantly, he is actually **quick and confident with maths facts** (addition, multiplication) — his difficulty is not number facts. Where he struggles is **word problems, place value, time, money, and fractions** — because these need reading comprehension and holding several steps in mind at once, which is hard for him. He is a strong **visual, hands-on learner** — he understands best when problems are drawn out, colour-coded, and worked step by step. He responds beautifully to patience, warmth and praise. We'll provide a short briefing on how he learns best, plus specific strategies from his learning assessment.



**What the sessions cover (two parts):**

1. First, support and complete his weekly Year 6 maths homework.

2. Then continue on Khan Academy, which we've set up to track his mastery. His maths has gaps going back to Year 3–4, so Khan Academy is how we fill those gaps and level him up at his own pace while homework keeps him current.



**How he needs to be taught (very important):**

- One or two steps at a time, given both spoken and in writing — he has very limited working memory, so never explain several steps at once

- Teach him to **read word problems carefully**: highlight/underline the key numbers and words, and have him say the strategy out loud before solving

- Record every step of the working on the shared whiteboard — don't let him do it all in his head

- Short blocks with a movement break — each 40-minute session runs as two ~15-minute blocks with a short break, not one long stretch

- Lots of visuals — draw the problem, colour-code, use diagrams

- Check understanding by having him explain it back in his own words

- He needs time to complete tasks — patience while he works through them is essential, not an inconvenience

- Fewer questions done well beats many done poorly

- Praise effort, correct gently — he loses confidence quickly



**Schedule (40-minute sessions):**

- Every weekday: **5:30–6:10pm Sydney time** (= 3:30pm Manila time)

- Saturday: **2:30–3:10pm Sydney time** (= 12:30pm Manila time)

- Please confirm you can commit to these times consistently.



**Technology required:**

- A **drawing / pen tablet** (XP-Pen, Huion, or Wacom) so you can write out equations and worked solutions live — our son writes on his own XP-Pen tablet during sessions

- Comfortable using a **shared online whiteboard** (Zoom Whiteboard, Microsoft Whiteboard, or similar) alongside video

- Reliable computer, webcam, and stable internet



**Also expected:**

- A brief weekly written report on what was covered, how he's progressing, and any gaps you're seeing



**Please answer these in your application (we read the answers carefully):**

1. Are you a licensed SPED teacher, or what is your teaching qualification?

2. How do you help a child who is good at number facts but struggles with maths word problems?

3. How do you teach a child who has trouble holding several steps in their head at once?

4. What experience do you have with ADHD or language-impaired children?

5. Do you have a drawing tablet and can you use a shared online whiteboard? Please confirm.

6. Please confirm you can commit to the schedule above, and include your hourly rate.



We'll shortlist based on your answers and then arrange a short paid trial session before confirming the ongoing role.

title: Amazon Product Sourcing VA / Online Arbitrage Product Researcher
description:
Amazon Product Sourcing VA — Online Arbitrage / Storefront Stalking



Starting Pay: $5.00/hour

Hours: 40 hours/week

Work Type: Remote | Full-Time



?



About the Role



We operate a growing Amazon resale business and are looking for a detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help source profitable products every day.



Your primary responsibility will be to use a sourcing strategy called Storefront Stalking. You’ll analyze Amazon seller storefronts, identify profitable products, locate suppliers online, and submit qualified buying opportunities for review.



This is a structured, analytical role. Success comes from following a proven process precisely and consistently—not from guessing or improvising. If you enjoy working within established systems and continuously improving, you’ll thrive here.



Every lead you submit will be reviewed. You’ll receive clear feedback explaining what was done correctly, what needs improvement, and why.



?



How the Position Works



3-Day Paid Trial



Your first 3 days are a paid trial.



As long as you follow the SOP and submit quality leads, you’ll be paid for every hour worked—no exceptions.



During the trial, you’ll:



* Follow our SOP

* Submit real product leads

* Receive feedback on your work



If your work meets our standards, you’ll move directly into the full-time position.



We don’t conduct lengthy interviews—your work speaks for itself.



?



Full-Time Position



Once hired, you’ll work approximately 40 hours per week sourcing profitable products.



You’ll continue receiving feedback on your submissions and will be expected to apply that feedback consistently.



VAs who take feedback seriously and improve over time are the ones who grow the fastest—and the ones we invest in the most.



Repeatedly making the same mistakes after they’ve been explained is the primary reason someone is removed from the role.



?



Growth Opportunities



Top performers may receive:



* Performance bonuses

* Pay increases

* Promotion into VA management

* Long-term opportunities, such as Sales Manager



If you consistently perform well and continue improving, there is a clear path for growth.



?



What We Provide



We’ve built this role to make success as straightforward as possible.



You’ll receive:



* A detailed step-by-step SOP

* A dedicated AI assistant trained on our workflows, sourcing criteria, and common questions

* Direct access to your manager whenever needed

* Continuous feedback to help you improve



?



Responsibilities



You will:



* Browse Amazon seller storefronts

* Analyze products using SellerAmp SAS

* Research suppliers through Google Shopping and retailer websites

* Apply coupons and discounts where available

* Simulate checkout to verify final costs

* Submit complete, accurate leads into Google Sheets

* Review feedback and continually improve



?



Product Requirements



Products generally must meet our sourcing criteria, including minimum requirements for:



* Sales Rank

* Monthly Sales

* ROI

* Profit

* Competition

* Buy Box stability

* Amazon presence

* IP safety

* Private label risk



All specific buying criteria will be covered during training.



?



Required Information for Every Lead



Each submission must include:



* Product title

* ASIN

* Amazon listing

* Supplier link

* Final buy cost

* Selling price used

* Estimated profit

* ROI

* Fulfillment method

* Monthly sales

* Sales Rank

* Offer count

* Promo codes used

* VA notes



Incomplete submissions will not be reviewed.



?



Requirements



Required



* Previous experience with Amazon Online Arbitrage

* Exceptional attention to detail

* Proficiency with Google Sheets

* Reliable internet connection and personal computer

* Good written English

* Ability to follow detailed processes independently



Preferred



* Experience with SellerAmp SAS and/or Keepa

* Experience calculating ROI and profit margins



?



Who This Role Is For



You’ll do well in this role if you’re:



* Patient

* Detail-oriented

* Methodical

* Coachable

* Comfortable following structured, analytical systems



This role is not a good fit if you regularly cut corners, guess, or ignore instructions.



If you enjoy learning, improving, and following proven systems, we’d love to hear from you.



?



Before You Apply



Please read this entire posting carefully.



Only apply if, when accepted, you’re ready to begin your 3-day paid trial within 24 hours.



To be considered, follow these instructions exactly:



1. Put Blueprint as the first word in the subject line.

2. Include your
 address.

3. Answer the questions below using numbered responses.

4. End your application with the phrase “Ready to learn.”

5. Do not attach a résumé.



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.



?



Questions



1. Describe your experience with Amazon Online Arbitrage. Include the tools you’ve used (SellerAmp, Keepa, etc.) and the types of sourcing you’ve done.



2. If you were following the SOP but discovered a more efficient way to complete the job, what would you do?



3. What number comes next?



3, 6, 12, 24, ____



4. If hired, are you able to begin your 3-day paid trial immediately (within 24 hours)? If not, when would you be available to start?

We are looking for someone who can take a winning ad and create an exact duplicate of it in another language while maintaining the same structure, pacing, style, and viewing experience.

Responsibilities



* Create UGC Ads

* Create AI-Generated Ads

* Extract and match background music from source videos

* Deliver high-quality video ads with fast turnaround times

* Handle revisions quickly and professionally

IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT



The most important skill for this position is the ability to create an EXACT DUPLICATE of an existing winning video ad.



We are NOT looking for editors who:



* Create their own version

* Add their own style

* Add their own creative ideas

* Take inspiration from the original video



We are looking for editors who can replicate a video exactly.



When given a source video, your job is to create a 1:1 copy of that video while changing only:

* Extensive experience with AI-generated ads

* Experience using HeyGen

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to follow scripts exactly

* Experience editing videos in German, French, and English

* Comfortable with revisions and feedback



Preferred Skills

* Experience identifying winning ad structures

* Experience scaling eCommerce brands

* Your portfolio

* Examples of Podcast Ads

title: Elite Acquisitions Closer U.S. Real Estate | Remote | USD Pay
description:
We run a high margin U.S. real estate niche most investors can't touch: partial deeds and title problems. We help families untangle complicated ownership and unlock properties nobody else knows how to close. The deals are unusual, the margins are strong, and the best closer on our team is closing roughly one deal a week.



We're hiring one more sharp closer. The bar is high on purpose.





What This Is





A real sales seat. You research families, get on the phone every day, and build trust with people in hard situations.

This is not a VA role. Not admin. Not "manage a pipeline quietly." You dial, you talk, you move deals.

You'll own leads inside Lofty (our CRM), dial through Dialpad, and pull contacts with SmartSkip.





Your Day





Daily huddle, 10:00 AM ET, cameras on, no exceptions. We review numbers, wins, and blockers together.

75 dials per day minimum, tracked. Your dials, contacts, and conversion are visible to the team every day.

Roughly 40 to 50% research (obituaries, court and tax records, identifying heirs and the real decision maker) and 50 to 60% outreach (calls, texts, voi
s, follow up).

We run a two call close structure. You'll learn it cold.





How We Operate (so you know before you apply)





We track activity daily. If you go dark for a day with no heads up, you won't last here.

We coach hard and expect you to be coachable. B+ players who show up beat A players who don't.

Full training from day one. Clear path to Senior Closer and team lead as you prove out.







What You Need





English at C1/C2 only. Families need to trust your voice on the phone.

5+ years sales experience. Real estate (acquisitions, wholesaling, probate, title) strongly preferred.

Total comfort with daily outbound calling, voi
s, and relentless follow up.

Sharp judgment on who the real decision maker is inside a family.

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, quality headset. Non negotiable.





Schedule





Full time, Monday to Friday

10:00 AM to 7:30 PM Eastern Time





Pay





Base: $1,000 to $1,500 USD per month based on experience

Commission: 10 to 15% depending on deal revenue. Our average deal is over $30,000, so a single close pays well.

Realistic total once ramped: $8,000 per month

Be clear eyed on timing: most reps lock their first deal within 30 days, and commission on that deal pays out around 100 days later once it closes and funds. This niche pays big, but it is not instant money. If you need a paycheck next week, this isn't the seat.







How to Apply



Send a 1 to 2 minute video covering:





Your sales and real estate background

How comfortable you truly are with heavy daily outbound calling

Why you're great at finding and speaking to the right decision maker in a family

Your location and availability

title: Very Organized Executive Assistant, Brand & Social Media heavy Remote | USA EST hours
description:
The application instructions at the bottom are specific. Only apply if you have direct experience as an assistant and with the applications below.



About us



We are a skincare brand serving women with acne-prone, barrier-compromised skin. We've been doing this for over fifteen years long before holistic skincare was a category anyone was chasing. Our clients don't find us through ads. They find us because someone they trust told them we were the ones who finally listened.



We're entering a new chapter. Our founder is stepping forward publicly as the lead content creator for the brand and the work ahead is connecting the woman who built this to the women it was built for.



We are a high-performance team. The pace is real and the standards are high but so is the care. We communicate directly, we don't let people struggle in silence, and we take genuine pride in what leaves our hands.



What this role is



We're hiring an assistant with strong social media skills — not a social media manager. The distinction matters, so here it is plainly:



A social media manager owns a channel. This role owns the founder's throughput. Content is a large part of the work, but it isn't the whole of it. You're the person who takes what's in her head at 9am and has it live, correct, and on-brand by end of day.  Must be an independent thinker.



Skill is required. Execution is the differentiator.



You will work in close, daily contact with the founder. Direction will change and sometimes mid-task. That isn't disorganization; it's what building a public brand looks like from the inside. The right person finds that energizing. The wrong person finds it exhausting, and we'd rather you know that now.  We are growing the brand not maintaining it.  This is an exciting role for someone who loves to get things done.



What you'll own



Execution and operations



- A high daily task load, consistently cleared — not carried forward

- Asana and Notion as living systems: every task updated as it moves, with enough written context that the founder never has to ask where something stands

- End-of-day reports, every day, without being asked. Done / in progress / blocked / needs a decision from the founder.

- Rapid pivots as priorities shift, with the judgment to flag when a pivot creates a conflict rather than silently dropping the previous thing



Content and brand



- Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube are our main platforms (this may expand) You will be responsible for calendar planning, scheduling, publishing

- Presenting plan to founder weekly during meetings

- Short-form video editing with strong hooks and retention-aware pacing

- Feminine, editorial-leaning graphics with a cohesive aesthetic across platforms

- Captions in the founder's voice, not a generic brand voice

- Repurposing single pieces of content into multiple formats across channels

- Community management — warm, professional, on-brand replies to comments and DMs

- Basic performance tracking: what worked, what didn't, what you'd do differently



Who we're looking for



- Highly adaptable. Change is the job. You reorganize around it without needing to be settled first.

- A strong communicator. You over-communicate rather than going quiet. Silence is the only real failure mode here.

- Genuinely organized. Nothing falls through, and nothing lives only in your head.

- Fast and finished. You'd rather ship something 90% right today and refine it than sit on something 100% right next week.

- Available USA EST hours. This is non-negotiable — the role requires real-time responsiveness.

- An eye for feminine luxury. Soft but powerful. Editorial. Elevated without being cold.

- An understanding of storytelling.

- Comfortable with: CapCut Pro, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere or Final Cut a plus)



Bonus if you



- Have worked with beauty, skincare, wellness, or feminine lifestyle brands

- Understand emotional storytelling and how women actually make skincare decisions

- Have supported a founder through a public-facing launch or rebrand



How to apply



 [ADDRESS] with the subject line: IN LOVE WITH SKINCARE



Include:



1. Your resume and experience.

2. Your portfolio — reels, TikToks, graphic design, Instagram feeds, video edits for BEAUTY

3. Links to brands you've worked with and before and afters, when you began working and after you left

4. Details on how many hours you have available

5. 3–5 videos you edited that performed well, and your honest read on why they performed





We also would like to know:



6. Something you've achieved in your personal life recently. Anything at all. Tell us why it mattered to you and why

7. A team you've been part of. What was your actual role on it — not your title, your role.

8. Any awards or recognition you've received, and what you're doing with that now.

9. A time direction changed on you mid-task. What did you do?

10. What beauty brands or creators you find visually excellent, and what makes content feel luxurious rather than expensive.



Lastly please confirm you are comfortable with the rate and your availability during EST hours is aligned.

title: SPED Teacher / Reading Specialist for 11-Year-Old with ADHD (Fluent English, Long-Term, Ongoing)
description:
SPED Teacher / Reading Specialist for 11-Year-Old with ADHD (Fluent English, Long-Term, Ongoing)



We're a Sydney (Australia) family looking for a patient, skilled online tutor to support our 11-year-old son with reading comprehension, vocabulary and general schoolwork. This is a long-term, ongoing role for the right person.



The ideal profile (this is what we're looking for):

- Licensed SPED (Special Education) teacher — this is our priority

- Reading / literacy intervention experience — comfortable teaching a child who reads below their grade level

- Experience with ADHD children — keeping an easily-distracted child engaged and on track

- Clear, fluent spoken English — essential, as our son has a speech delay and English is his second language (Spanish is spoken at home)



If you don't tick every box but you're a strong SPED teacher or a primary teacher with real reading-intervention experience, we'd still like to hear from you.



About our son:

He is in Year 6 (NSW/Australian curriculum), friendly, hard-working and keen to do well. He has ADHD and a language impairment. His reading comprehension and vocabulary are his biggest challenges and currently sit below his grade level, so we need someone who can teach foundational reading skills while keeping the material age-appropriate for an 11-year-old (he loves Lego, cooking, and sport). He responds beautifully to patience, warmth and praise. We'll provide a short briefing on how he learns best, plus specific strategies from his learning assessment.



What the sessions cover:

- First, support and complete his weekly homework in English, basic science, and religious education (we're a Catholic family, so comfort supporting Catholic religious-education homework is a plus)

- Then the main focus: reading comprehension, making inferences, and vocabulary building — this is his biggest area of need. We'll provide reading books as PDFs.



How he needs to be taught (very important):

- One or two instructions at a time, given both spoken and in writing — he has very limited working memory

- Short blocks with movement breaks — each session runs as two ~15-minute blocks with a short break, not one long stretch

- Lots of visuals — highlighting key words, drawing, colour-coding

- Check understanding by having him explain it back in his own words

- Praise effort, correct gently — he loses confidence quickly



Schedule (40-minute sessions):

- Every weekday: 6:30pm Sydney time (= 4:30pm Manila time)

- Saturday: 3:30pm Sydney time (= 1:30pm Manila time)

- 6 sessions per week. Please confirm you can commit to these times consistently.



Technology required:

- Reliable computer, webcam, and stable internet

- Comfortable sharing/reading PDFs on screen and using video (Zoom or Google Meet)



Also expected:

- A brief weekly written report on what was covered and how his comprehension is progressing



Please answer these in your application (we read the answers carefully):

1. Are you a licensed SPED teacher, or what is your teaching qualification?

2. Have you taught reading comprehension to a child who reads below their grade level? Tell us briefly how you approached it.

3. How do you teach a child to make an inference from a text?

4. What experience do you have with ADHD or language-impaired children?

5. Please confirm you can commit to the schedule above, and include your hourly rate.



We'll shortlist based on your answers and then arrange a short paid trial session before confirming the ongoing role.

title: Practice Operations Coordinator (Virtual, Full-Time) — US Dermatology Practice
description:
Practice Operations Coordinator (Virtual, Full-Time) — US Dermatology Practice



Full-time | Long-term, dedicated role | Pacific Time hours | $12-15/hour based on experience



We are an established, independent dermatology and skin cancer surgery practice in Southern California. Our physician-owner runs a tight, well-documented operation — written SOPs for every workflow, shared tracking logs, and a small team of long-term virtual staff — and we are hiring a senior-level coordinator to become the operational backbone of that system.



This is not a task-list VA position. We are looking for someone with real US healthcare insurance experience who can monitor, audit, and follow through without being reminded — a person who notices what's slipping before the doctor does.



What you'll own





Daily operations report. Each morning, you'll review our tracking systems (authorization queues, pathology follow-up, compliance calendar) and send the physician a short daily report: what's on track, what's aging, who owns what. This report is the heartbeat of the role.

Compliance calendar. You'll own our deadline calendar (trainings, renewals, audits, regulatory items) — not just watching the reminders, but converting each one into an assigned, tracked task and following it to completion.

Refund adjudication. You'll review credit balances at the ledger level — charges, contractual adjustments, insurance and patient payments — and determine whether each credit is a true overpayment, a posting error, or a payer takeback in waiting. You'll prepare documented refund requests (correct payee, amount, and evidence) for physician approval. (You will not disburse funds — approval and payment stay with the practice.)

Medication prior authorizations. You'll own our low-volume medication PA queue end to end: submission, follow-up, and tracking to approval or appeal, with status visible in your daily report.

Insurance quality audit. You'll spot-check the team's insurance verifications, authorizations, and referrals against our written protocols and payer rules, and flag anything done wrong or not done at all.

Backup coverage. You'll cross-train on our pathology results and authorization workflows so critical queues never depend on a single person.





What we require





3+ years supporting US medical practices in a role involving insurance: verification, prior authorizations, referrals, eligibility, denials, or billing. You should be comfortable explaining the difference between an HMO, a PPO, and a Medicare Advantage plan — and what each means for getting a surgery authorized.

Payment-posting literacy. You can read an EOB/ERA and a patient ledger — charges, contractual adjustments, payments — and explain why an account shows a credit balance. If you have worked payment posting, credit balance resolution, or refunds for a US practice, say so specifically.

Self-directed follow-through. Most of this work is silent. No patient will complain if you skip it — which is exactly why it matters. We need someone who treats an unwatched queue the same as a watched one.

Excellent written English. Your daily report goes directly to the physician.

Reliable infrastructure: backup power source and backup internet connection are required, and you'll be asked to describe your setup.

Availability during US Pacific business hours (at minimum, a substantial overlap including mornings).

Dermatology experience is a plus, not a requirement. Experience with ModMed/EMA, prior authorization portals, or medical fax platforms is a plus.





What we offer





A stable, long-term seat with a physician-owner who invests in systems and in people. Our virtual tea
mbers are treated as core staff, not contractors passing through.

Clearly documented workflows — you will never be guessing what "done right" looks like.

A defined growth path: as you demonstrate judgment, your decision-making authority expands on a written schedule, and this role is positioned to grow into revenue-cycle work if the practice brings billing in-house.

Paid trial week so both sides can evaluate the fit with real work.





How to apply



Send the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.





Your resume, with US healthcare clients/employers and dates.

A short answer (5–10 sentences) to this scenario: A patient calls to book a surgical consultation and provides an insurance plan you've never seen before. Walk us through, step by step, everything you would do to assess this plan before the visit — and tell us what you would report back to the practice when you finished.

A short answer (3–6 sentences) to this scenario: A patient's account shows a $180 credit balance. List what you would check, in order, before d
 whether it should be refunded — and how you would know whether the refund belongs to the patient or the insurance company.

One paragraph describing a time you caught a problem your employer didn't know existed.

Your internet and power backup setup.

Use the subject line: Coordinator — [your first name] — Sentinel





We respond to every complete application within one week.
