title: Director of Operation
description:
Director of Operations (Marketing Agency & Multi-Brand Ecosystem)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $10 per hour + performance-based bonuses

Reports To: Founder



About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Director of Operations to lead operations across a fast-growing ecosystem of brands spanning creative services, coworking, content production, community programming, experiential events, and digital education.



This is not an administrative or entry-level operations role. We are looking for a senior operator who can transform vision into execution, build scalable systems, improve profitability, and lead high-performing teams across multiple businesses.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience in operations leadership and project management, with a strong background in marketing and hands-on experience managing or supporting a marketing agency environment. Candidates must also have proven success overseeing teams, projects, and company operations in a fully remote setting.



You will serve as the operational leader responsible for bringing structure, accountability, and strategic execution across all brands while ensuring smooth day-to-day operations.



Brands You Will Oversee

The Bakery Cowork – A female-focused coworking and content ecosystem

The Icing Agency – A full-service creative and experiential marketing agency

Creamery Studios – A production, event, and podcast studio

Gurl Mobb – A digital membership and community platform for women entrepreneurs

Gurl Mobb Museum – An immersive brand and community experience designed to empower and connect women entrepreneurs



Required Qualifications: 

Minimum of 3 years of experience in operations management, project management, or senior leadership roles.

Previous experience as a Director of Operations, Operations Manager, COO, or similar leadership position.

Strong background in marketing, digital marketing, or agency operations.

Experience working within or overseeing a marketing agency is highly preferred.

Demonstrated success managing teams, systems, and company operations remotely.

Proven ability to oversee multiple departments and business units in a virtual environment.

Proven ability to build SOPs, workflows, and operational systems from scratch.

Strong understanding of financial metrics, profitability, and business performance.

Advanced proficiency in project management platforms such as ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, or similar tools.

Exceptional leadership, communication, and conflict-resolution skills.

Ability to make difficult decisions and drive accountability across teams.



Ideal Candidate Profile

You are someone who:

- Thinks strategically and operationally.

- Understands both marketing performance and business profitability.

- Can simplify complexity and create structure.

- Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

- Leads confidently and communicates directly.

- Protects leadership time and focuses on high-impact priorities.

- Is comfortable challenging ideas respectfully when necessary.

- Solves problems through systems rather than temporary fixes.



Key Success Metrics (First 6 Months)

- Improved operational clarity across all brands.

- Clear organizational structure and role accountability.

- Company-wide KPI dashboards implemented.

- Increased operational efficiency and profitability.

- Stronger leadership team autonomy.

- Reduced founder overwhelm and decision fatigue.

- Streamlined marketing and agency workflows.



Who This Role Is NOT For

Entry-level project managers.

Executive assistants or virtual assistants.

Pure creatives without operational experience.

Individuals who avoid accountability or difficult conversations.

Candidates without experience managing teams, systems, and business operations.



Who This Role Is For

This role is designed for a high-level operator who wants to help scale an ambitious multi-brand ecosystem. If you have experience leading teams, building systems, managing marketing operations, and turning vision into results, we would love to hear from you.

title: SEO Specialist
description:
About Exponential Oaks



Exponential Oaks is a web development and digital marketing agency specializing in websites, SEO, and paid ads for health & wellness businesses — med spas, wellness centers, chiropractic and functional health practices, and beauty/aesthetics brands. We're currently building out our presence across Georgia, starting in the Coweta, Fayette, and South Fulton County region before expanding statewide.



Our current client portfolio includes health & wellness brands like CMI Health, Aura Health, Function Health, and Total Esthetics, alongside select projects in other industries. We build fast, modern, high-performing websites (React, Next.js, Vercel) and pair them with real marketing systems — not just a pretty site with no way to generate leads.



We're a small, fast-moving team (founder + software engineer currently), looking to bring on specialists who can own their channel end-to-end and grow with us as we scale.





About the role



You'll own local and technical SEO across our health & wellness client sites and our own agency site, with a strong focus on Google Business Profile management and review generation. This is a hands-on execution role — you'll be working against a documented playbook, not building SEO strategy from scratch.







Responsibilities



Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles for agency and client accounts (categories, service areas, posts, photos, Q&A)

Keyword research and on-page SEO for health & wellness search terms (treatment names, local + service intent)

Technical SEO maintenance: meta titles/descriptions, Open Graph tags, sitemap.xml, 
 markup (LocalBusiness, ProfessionalService, MedicalBusiness where relevant)

Local SEO / map-pack ranking strategy across Georgia service areas, starting hyper-local (Coweta/Fayette/South Fulton)

Review generation strategy and execution — prompting, tracking, and responding to reviews across client GBP profiles

Monthly reporting on rankings, organic traffic, and GBP engagement





Requirements



Proven experience managing SEO for local/small businesses (health, wellness, beauty, or medical a strong plus)

Hands-on experience with Google Business Profile management

Familiarity with Google Search Console, Google Analytics (GA4), and at least one SEO tool (Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar)

Understanding of schema markup and technical on-page SEO fundamentals

Strong written and spoken English

Comfortable working async, self-directed, against documented SOPs and KPIs





Nice to have



Experience with health & wellness, med spa, or beauty industry clients specifically

Familiarity with React/Vite or Next.js sites (you won't be writing code, but understanding how content maps to these platforms helps)

Experience managing SEO across multiple client accounts at once

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
About Exponential Oaks



Exponential Oaks is a web development and digital marketing agency specializing in websites, SEO, and paid ads for health & wellness businesses — med spas, wellness centers, chiropractic and functional health practices, and beauty/aesthetics brands. We're currently building out our presence across Georgia, starting in the Coweta, Fayette, and South Fulton County region before expanding statewide.



Our current client portfolio includes health & wellness brands like CMI Health, Aura Health, Function Health, and Total Esthetics, alongside select projects in other industries. We build fast, modern, high-performing websites (React, Next.js, Vercel) and pair them with real marketing systems — not just a pretty site with no way to generate leads.



We're a small, fast-moving team (founder + software engineer currently), looking to bring on specialists who can own their channel end-to-end and grow with us as we scale.



About the role



Note: the Requirements section below is what actually matters for applying — everything under "Nice to have" and "Other marketing channels" is upside, not a checklist you need to fully match. If you meet the core requirements, apply even if you don't have every extra skill listed.



You'll own both SEO and paid advertising for our health & wellness clients and our own agency growth — Google Business Profile, technical/local SEO, Google Local Services Ads, Search Ads, and Meta 
/Instagram) Ads. This is a combined role for someone comfortable working across both channels rather than specializing deeply in one. You'll be executing against a documented playbook and existing tracking setup, not building strategy from scratch.



Responsibilities



SEO (roughly 50%)



Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles (categories, service areas, posts, photos, Q&A)

Keyword research and on-page SEO for health & wellness search terms

Technical SEO maintenance: meta titles/descriptions, Open Graph tags, sitemap.xml, 
 markup

Local SEO strategy across Georgia service areas, starting hyper-local (Coweta/Fayette/South Fulton)

Review generation strategy and execution





Paid Ads (roughly 50%)



Set up and manage Google Local Services Ads (LSA) for eligible clients

Build and manage Google Search and Meta 
/Instagram) ad campaigns

Monitor and optimize budgets, bids, and targeting based on conversion data

Work with existing case-study assets (Total Esthetics, CMI Health, Aura Health, Function Health) to build ad creative

Maintain and troubleshoot conversion tracking (GA4, Google Ads tag, Meta Pixel)





Both



Combined monthly reporting — rankings, traffic, GBP engagement, ad performance, and cost-per-lead in one view





Requirements



Experience with both SEO and paid ads for local/small businesses — doesn't need to be deep expertise in each, but real hands-on exposure to both

Familiarity with Google Business Profile, Google Ads/LSA, and Meta Ads Manager

Comfortable with GA4 and basic conversion tracking concepts

Strong written and spoken English

Comfortable working async, self-directed, against documented SOPs and KPIs

Health & wellness, med spa, or beauty industry experience a plus





Nice to have / Extra skills



Basic copywriting — ad copy, GBP posts, landing page headlines/CTAs

Familiarity with HubSpot (forms, workflows, contact/deal pipeline) — we use it for lead tracking

Basic
 marketing experience (Mailchimp or similar) — nurture sequences, review request campaigns

Canva or basic graphic design — ad creative, GBP photo posts

Social media posting/scheduling experience (Instagram/Facebook business pages)

Review management — responding to and encouraging Google/Facebook reviews

Basic competitor research — identifying what's working for other local health & wellness businesses

Comfortable in Google Sheets/Excel for reporting and tracking

Google Tag Manager — more robust tracking setup than a basic pixel install, useful as we add more conversion events

Awareness of healthcare/medical advertising policies (Google and Meta both restrict certain health-related ad targeting and claims) — relevant given clients like CMI Health and Function Health

Basic conversion rate optimization (CRO) / A/B testing concepts — headline, CTA, and landing page testing

Local citation/directory management (Yelp, Healthgrades, Vagaro, and other wellness-specific directories beyond Google)

Short-form video basics (Reels/TikTok-style content) — high-performing format for beauty/wellness before-and-after and behind-the-scenes content

Landing page builder experience (Unbounce, Webflow, or similar) — helpful even though our core sites are custom-built

Experience managing multiple client accounts/campaigns simultaneously without mixing up budgets or reporting

AI-assisted content creation (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) for scaling ad copy, GBP posts, and blog content across multiple clients without sacrificing quality

Familiarity with Google's AI-driven campaign types (Performance Max) — increasingly relevant as manual campaign management becomes less effective

No-code automation tools (Zapier, Make) — ability to connect our lead capture, CRM, and
 systems into repeatable workflows without needing a developer for every change

Looker Studio (or similar) for building reusable, scalable reporting dashboards as we add more clients

Awareness of AI/generative search behavior (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT search) and how it's changing traditional SEO — sometimes called answer engine optimization or generative engine optimization

Automated review request tools (SMS/email-triggered) — helps the review-generation responsibility scale without manual outreach per client





Other marketing channels/disciplines that would benefit us



Beyond core SEO and paid search/social, exposure to any of these is a plus — they're channels we may expand into as we scale:





SMS marketing — appointment reminders, promotions, and review requests; a strong fit for spa/wellness booking behavior

Content marketing/blogging — educational content around treatments and services, supports both SEO and patient/client trust

TikTok Ads — beauty and wellness content performs especially well here; a natural extension of the short-form video skill already listed

YouTube/video ads — longer-form before-and-after, testimonial, or educational content

Geofencing/location-based mobile ads — targeting nearby mobile users, useful for hyper-local service areas

Local partnership/referral marketing — cross-promotion with adjacent local businesses (gyms, salons, wellness-adjacent retailers)

Influencer/micro-influencer marketing — local wellness and beauty influencers for authentic reach

Marketplace/directory advertising — Yelp Ads, Nextdoor Ads, beyond organic directory listings

PR/local media outreach — local press, community features, and earned media

Event or pop-up marketing — open houses, community events tied to client locations
